Resolve handler of card 0x143e: for handler-table selector 0 runs duel_effects_destroy_old_field_spell_step and, when it returns 0, both players gain 600 Life Points (duel_core_gain_lp); for other selectors inflicts 100 damage on the controller's opponent (duel_core_inflict_damage). Returns 0. Side effects: LP changes, field-spell replacement. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1445 (state in 0x09e28f60). Selector 2 (byte ctx+3 bits 4-5) outside event code 0x24: 0x80 adds a Deck copy of the card (duel_core_find_deck_card_by_name, duel_core_add_deck_card_to_hand) when the owner has a Deck and may add from it (returns 100), otherwise hint 0x15 and 0x6f (show the Deck to the opponent); 100 shuffles. Otherwise: with fewer than 3 instance markers 0x1445 (duel_core_count_instance_markers), 0x80 shows hint 0x5e when duel_effects_count_candidates finds one (0x7f), 0x7f opens card list mode 6, 0x7e adds the chosen card to the hand from the Graveyard (duel_core_add_graveyard_card_to_hand) or the Deck, 0x7d posts instance marker (card id, kind 5) and, when the card is still in its slot with flag bit 2 clear, returns it to the Deck (0x7c shuffles the searched Decks); with 3 or more markers, 0x80 gives link target 0 (valid, accepted by duel_effects_call_handler_08_b) a kind-2 effect (duel_effects_attach_effect_to_slot, key 0x1445) of ATK x opposing monster count / 10, capped 0xffff. Side effects: hand adds, markers, return to Deck, effect attachment. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1446 (sub-state 0x09e28f60). 0x80: duel_effects_revive_target(ctx) -> 0x7f when it succeeds, else 0. 0x7f: v = 200 x the number of owner's Graveyard monsters of races 0x0b, 0x0d and 0x10 (duel_core_count_graveyard_by_race); when non-zero attaches a kind-2 effect (card id, v) to every face-up opponent monster (duel_effects_attach_effect_to_slot). Returns 0. Side effects: summon, effect records. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Shared resolve handler of cards 0x1457, 0x1452, 0x144c and 0x1449. When the table selector (ctx+3 bits 4-5) is not 2 it only registers a delayed effect: player marker (controller, card, 1, own instance) and hint 0x9c, then ends. Selector 2: 0x80 ends when duel_effects_build_candidate_list(owner, card, 0) is empty, else shows hint 0x4d (0x1457), 0x4e (0x1452) or 0x4c (0x144c, 0x1449); 0x7f opens duel_core_open_card_list(owner, 6, card, 0); 0x7e for 0x1457 adds the selected Graveyard card to the hand (duel_core_add_graveyard_card_to_hand), for 0x1452 and 0x144c returns it to the Deck with top = 0 and for 0x1449 with top = 1 (duel_effects_return_graveyard_card_to_deck), and ends. Returns the next sub-state. Side effects: marker, hints, card moves. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler shared by 5 cards (first 0x1450): when the link card is face-up, refreshes its location, re-checks the activation condition (duel_effects_call_handler_0c_b(ctx, arg)) and, if it still holds, restores the original side bit in ctx+2 and returns duel_effects_resolve_lp_change(ctx); otherwise 0. Side effects: those of the LP change. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1462 (each player gives a hand card to the other); does nothing when the effect state (ctx byte +4 bits 2-3) is non-zero. 0x80 ends unless both hands (0x09e2a534, 0x09e2b070) are non-empty, else duel_core_request_choose_opponent_hand_card(owner, card, 1); 0x7f stores the instance of the opponent's hand card at index 0x09e2d2fa in u16 +8 and lets the opponent choose; 0x7e stores the owner's chosen hand card in u16 +0x0a and pushes command 0x3e moving the opponent's card into the owner's hand (location 0x16 = 0x0b << 1); 0x7d pushes 0x3e moving the owner's card into the opponent's hand and ends. Returns the next sub-state. Side effects: prompts, two move commands, ctx +8/+0x0a. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1468 (state in 0x09e28f60): nothing unless the effect state is 0 and the card is still in its slot with flag bit 2 clear. With table selector 0 posts command 0x60 (bit 15 for side 1) with a = 0, b = own slot. Otherwise the stage in slot value +0x0c (0-3) selects the next card to place (0x1497, 0x1498, 0x1499, 0x149a): 0x80 needs a free spell/trap zone and builds the candidate list for it (hint 0xf6, 0x7f; none: hint 0x0d, 0x78 shows hand and Deck to the opponent); 0x7f opens card list mode 6; 0x7e requests a spell/trap zone for the chosen card (duel_core_request_spell_trap_zone) and continues with 0x7c from the Deck or 0x7d from the hand; both increment the stage (duel_core_post_set_slot_value), place the card face-up in zone 0x09e2d2d8 (duel_core_place_named_deck_card_on_field, or duel_core_post_place_list_card_on_field from the hand), post command 0x60 with a = stage + 1, b = zone, and shuffle the Deck unless the stage was 3; from the hand, when player slot 11 holds marker 0x1379 with that instance (duel_core_has_marker_value), announces 0x1379 and inflicts 2000 damage on the owner. Side effects: placements, commands 0x60, damage, shuffle. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x146b (battle effect that hands the attack to another monster), stepping sub-state 0x09e28f60. 0x80: only when ctx byte +4 bits 2-3 are 0, bit 0 of 0x09e2bba0 is clear and bit 1 set, and the attacker's (0x09e28620/0x09e2863c) flags word has bit 25; link target 1 must be valid and face-up and link target 0 valid, face-up and affected (duel_effects_is_slot_unaffected false): posts command 0x19 (a = target 0 slot, b = 1) and clears duel flag 1 (duel_core_post_set_duel_flag) -> 0x7f. 0x7f: the attack target still has the instance recorded in the defender's battle record (0x09e2865c), target 1 is valid, face-up and affected; a Defense Position target 1 is switched (duel_effects_change_position(ctx, side, slot, 0, 0)) -> 0x7e. 0x7e: when target 1 is in Attack Position, declares its attack: command 0x17 (a = its slot, b = defending side | target slot << 8) or, for a direct attack, command 0x18 (b = not replay flag 0x09e28638) -> 0x7d. 0x7d: duel_core_request_effect_battle(0, 1) and finishes. Returns the next sub-state or 0. Side effects: battle commands, position change, duel flag, effect battle request. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x146f (Special Summon from the Deck): sub-state 0x80 needs a free Monster Zone and duel_core_can_special_summon, then shows hint 0x11d with candidates (duel_effects_build_candidate_list) or hint 0x0d without; 0x7f opens card list mode 6, 0x7e Special Summons the selected candidate; 0x6e (no candidate) shows the owner's hand and Deck to the opponent (duel_core_request_show_hand_and_deck(opponent, 1, 1)); 100 shuffles the owner's Deck. Returns the next sub-state or 0. Side effects: Special Summon, reveal, shuffle. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1470 (sub-state 0x09e28f60). 0x80: duel_effects_resolve_negate_activation(ctx, prev) -> 0x7f. 0x7f: when some slot passes duel_effects_target_filter_1461_198c asks yes/no (message 0x68) -> 0x7e, else 0. 0x7e: yes opens duel_core_begin_select_target(owner, card id, -1, that filter) -> 0x7d. 0x7d: unconfirmed -> 0x7f; confirmed opens a timing batch, destroys the chosen slot (duel_core_request_destroy_slot) and stores its ATK in 0x09e28f64 -> 0x7c. 0x7c: when something was destroyed (0x09e2bbbc) inflicts 0x09e28f64 damage to the opponent; closes the batch -> 0. Side effects: negation, prompt, selection, destruction, damage. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler (state in 0x09e28f60) that sends chosen cards from the owner's Deck to the Graveyard: 0x80 needs 2 cards for 0x1d3e, else 1 (count in 0x09e28f64); builds the candidate list with duel_effects_get_candidate_param; too few shows hint 0x0d (0x78 shows the Deck to the opponent, 100 shuffles), otherwise hint 0x3a, opens a timing batch and returns 0x7f; 0x7f opens card list mode 6 (one pick) or mode count + 6 (up to 0x20); 0x7e sends each picked card (duel_core_get_picked_candidate, duel_core_send_deck_ref_to_graveyard(owner, instance, card, 0)) counting down, then closes the batch; card 0x1dc2 then, when the first pick reached the Graveyard and link target 0 is valid and accepted by duel_effects_call_handler_08_b, attaches a kind-2 effect with key 0x1d43 and the picked card's id to the target (duel_effects_attach_effect_to_slot); returns 100 to shuffle. Side effects: Deck-to-Graveyard commands, effect attachment, shuffle. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1475: unless the event code is 0x24, posts a player record (owner, card id, 1, 0); when target 0 is still valid and passes the +08 filter, stores its ATK (capped at 0xffff) in ctx+0x0c and destroys every slot accepted by duel_effects_target_filter_17db (duel_effects_collect_slot_mask, duel_core_request_destroy_mask). Returns 0. Side effects: record, ctx+0x0c, destruction. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of cards 0x1481 and 0x1619 (sub-state 0x09e28f60). 0x80: requires duel_core_can_special_summon(owner) and a non-empty duel_effects_build_candidate_list(owner, card id, 0) (else hint 0x122, 0); 0x1481 then needs another tributable monster (duel_core_count_tributable_monsters) and requests one Tribute (duel_core_request_tribute_for_effect(owner, own location, 1)) -> 0x7f, 0x1619 -> 0x7e. 0x7f: Tributes the chosen mask (u32 0x09e2d2fc) -> 0x7e. 0x7e: with a free monster zone shows hint 0x1a -> 0x7d, else 0. 0x7d: opens the card list (mode 6) -> 0x7c. 0x7c: Special Summons the selected candidate face-up (position argument card id << 16) -> 0. Side effects: Tribute, hint, list, summon. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1482: when the card is still face-up in its slot with flag bit 2 clear, attaches a kind-0x12 record keyed by the card id with value ((count x 75) & 0x3fff) << 2, count being the number of cards banished by the activation step (link u16 +0x08) (duel_core_post_add_marker). Returns 0. Side effects: marker command. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x148d (move every equip card to the target); does nothing when the effect state is non-zero or link target 0 is invalid. 0x80 clears the masks u16 +0x0a/+0x0c, opens a timing batch. 0x7f scans spell/trap zones 5-9 of both sides (turn player 0x09e2d1d8 first) for occupied slots with a non-zero duel_core_get_slot_activation_kind that are not yet linked to the target (duel_core_get_link_kind_from == 0): one that duel_effects_can_equip_to rejects is marked in mask u16 +0x0a + side x 2; one that may move and has bits 1 and 3 of slot word +0x10 clear is moved to the target (duel_core_move_equip_card) and the state repeats; when the movable slot is the link's own slot, copies ctx u16 +8 to link +8. Then 0x7e destroys the marked equips (duel_core_request_destroy_mask(ctx, u32 +0x0a)), closes the batch and ends. Returns the next sub-state. Side effects: equip moves, destruction, timing batch, ctx/link fields. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x148e (negate a flip effect): a spell/trap activation (table selector 0) needs a previous link prev whose card has flip kind 1 (card_db_get_flip_kind); other selectors need the event argument u32 ctx+0x14 to be 0. Unless duel_effects_cannot_be_negated(prev, 1) protects prev, and unless prev's card still sits in its monster zone and is unaffected by ctx, shows the negation (duel_core_post_show_negation) and sets prev +4 bit 1 (activation negated), bits 2-3 = 1 (negated) and bit 4 (sent to the Graveyard after the chain). Returns 0. Side effects: prev +4, negation display. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1490: ends unless the effect state is 0, the card is still in its slot (instance match, bit 2 of slot word +0x10 clear) and u16 +8 is non-zero. 0x80 ends when duel_effects_count_valid_targets(ctx) is 0; a CPU owner destroys the first monster (slots 0-4, opponent first) accepted by duel_effects_call_handler_08_b and ends; a human owner gets hint 0x6d and duel_core_begin_select_target(owner, card, 0, duel_effects_call_handler_08_b) and goes to 0x7f. 0x7f destroys the confirmed slot (duel_core_request_destroy_slot) and ends, or returns to 0x80 on a cancel. Returns the next sub-state. Side effects: destruction request, selection. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x1494: at sub-state 0x80 requests a die roll (duel_core_request_die_roll(owner, slot, card id)) and returns 0x7f; at 0x7f stores the result (u16 0x09e2d2fa) in u16 ctx+0x08, which its slot +08 filter compares with the Level, and destroys every slot of duel_effects_collect_target_mask(ctx) (duel_core_request_destroy_mask), returning 0. Side effects: die roll, ctx+0x08, destroy request. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x149b (state in 0x09e28f60): 0x80, when link target 0 is valid and holds a face-down card, flips it face-up (duel_effects_flip_card_face) and shows it; a non-trap card, or any card when the effective card id is 0x1258, is flipped back face-down; a trap that can be activated (duel_effects_can_activate_set_card) is announced and queued as a chain link (duel_core_chain_queue_link with card id, side bit 31, 0x46000000, slot << 16, instance); a trap that cannot be activated returns 0x7f, where the target is destroyed (duel_core_request_destroy_target_slot); every other path returns 100. 100 returns the card itself to the Deck when it is still in its slot with flag bit 2 clear (99 shuffles the searched Decks). Side effects: face changes, chain link, destruction, return to Deck. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x149d: sub-state 0x80 destroys the card in its linked slot (duel_core_find_linked_slot, duel_core_request_destroy_slot) and returns 0x7f; 0x7f, when that happened (0x09e2bbbc != 0) and this card is now banished (location 0x0f) or in the Graveyard (0x0e), queues a trigger for it (duel_core_chain_queue_trigger(card id | location << 16 | side << 31 | 0x38400000, instance, 0)). Returns 0x7f or 0. Side effects: destruction, trigger queue. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of cards 0x149e and 0x1b1d: takes the last recorded value (n = ctx+7 bits 1-7) as a card reference (duel_effects_get_link_target_ref(ctx, n - 1)); when that card is banished (location 0x0f) returns it to the Graveyard (duel_core_return_banished_card_to_graveyard), decrements the count and returns 0x80 so that it is called again; returns 0 when no values remain. Side effects: cards moved, ctx+7. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x14a6: inside a timing batch, for every occupied opponent Monster Zone it flips face-down Attack Position monsters face-up (duel_effects_flip_card_face(..., 2)), changes Defense Position monsters to Attack Position (duel_effects_change_position, face-up flag from slot +0x08) and attaches a kind-3 effect keyed by the card id with value 500 (duel_effects_attach_effect_to_slot); afterwards posts a player record on the opponent (card id, kind 1, 0). Returns 0. Side effects: flips, position changes, effect records. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler (state in 0x09e28f60; nothing when the effect state is non-zero) that destroys a class of field cards and changes LP per card destroyed: 0x80 builds in 0x09e28f64 a mask (bit side x 16 + slot over all 11 slots of both sides) of spells (card 0x14aa), monsters (0x16d7), non-monsters (0x19b0) or all occupied slots (others), opens a timing batch, destroys the targets (duel_effects_collect_target_mask, duel_core_request_destroy_mask) and returns 0x7f. 0x7f counts the destroyed ones (mask & handled mask 0x09e2bbbc) and applies: 0x1665 owner gains 800 each, 0x170f owner gains 500 each, 0x1bad and 0x14aa 500 damage each to the opponent, 0x1d9c, 0x18dc and 0x16d7 300 each, 0x19b0 100 each to the controller's opponent; closes the batch. Returns the next state or 0. Side effects: destruction, LP change. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Resolve handler of card 0x14ab (sub-state 0x09e28f60). 0x80: when duel_effects_call_handler_0c_b() is non-zero, -> 0x6e if the opponent has no monsters in hand, otherwise asks the owner to choose an opponent hand card (duel_core_request_choose_opponent_hand_card(owner, card id, 1)) -> 0x7f. 0x7f: posts command 0x3e (a = opponent | 0x16 | instance of the chosen hand card at index 0x09e2d2fa << 6, b = owner | 0x16 | owner hand count << 6; presumably moves it to the owner's hand, hypothesis medium) -> 0. 0x6e: shows the opponent's hand to the owner (duel_core_request_show_hand(owner)) -> 0. Side effects: selection, command 0x3e, hand reveal. No direct caller (effect table slot +04).

Shared resolve helper for Union-style equip/unequip effects, stepping sub-state 0x09e28f60. 0x80: the card must still be the same instance in its slot, flag bit 2 clear and face-up (duel_effects_is_link_card_face_up). Returns the next sub-state or 0. Side effects: card movement, equip links, control change, Special Summon, destruction, markers, statistics, 0x09e290bc. Callers: 3 (duel_effects_resolve_15d3_1916, duel_effects_resolve_15cf, duel_effects_resolve_1f1f).

Resolve handler of card 0x15cf: in mode 2 (u16 ctx+0x0c) it locates the card reference u16 ctx+0x0e (duel_core_find_card_location) and, if it is a face-up card in a Monster Zone, adds a marker keyed by the card id (kind 2, value 0) to it, returning 0; in other modes it returns duel_effects_resolve_union_equip (tail call). Resolve handler of card 0x15dd (sub-state 0x09e28f60), run once per side: side = turn player xor index 0x09e28f64. 0x80 resets the index and opens a timing batch; 0x80/0x7f: when the side may banish from the other side's Graveyard and duel_effects_build_candidate_list(side, card id, 0) is non-empty, asks it yes/no (duel_core_request_yes_no(side, card id, 0x55)) -> 0x7e, else -> 0x64. 0x7e: yes -> duel_core_request_select_list_cards(side, card id, 3) -> 0x7d; no -> 0x64. 0x7d: banishes the picked cards (count 0x09e2d2fa, references from 0x09e2d2fc) from the other side's Graveyard (by_opponent 1) -> 0x64. 0x64: next side -> 0x7f, after both closes the batch -> 0. Resolve handler of card 0x15f7, a Union equip/unequip effect (state in 0x09e28f60), by mode u16 ctx+0x0c. Resolve handler of card 0x1ac6: when duel flag bit 0 (0x09e2bba0) is clear and target 0 is still valid and passes the +08 filter, first, with flag bit 1 set and the attacker still attacking (duel_core_is_attacking_monster) with slot flag bit 25, pushes command 0x1f (attack negation; a = attacker slot, bit 15 for attacker side 1); then attaches a kind-3 record keyed by the card id with value 2000 to the target. Resolve handler of card 0x1aca. Resolve handler of card 0x1afb. 0x80 when link target 0 is valid and accepted by duel_effects_call_handler_08_b stores its name id in u16 +0x0a and its owner (slot byte +1 bit 6) in u16 +0x0c, returns it to the Deck (duel_core_request_return_slot_to_deck) and goes to 0x81. 0x81 when a card was handled shuffles that owner's Deck. 0x7f ends unless that owner has a free Monster Zone, the ctx owner may Special Summon and duel_effects_build_candidate_list(owner, card, u32 +0x0a) is non-empty; hint 0xf0. 0x7e opens duel_core_open_card_list(owner, 6, card, u32 +0x0a). 0x7d Special Summons the selected card for that owner (flags card << 16, plus 0x10 when it is not the ctx owner) and ends.
