Direct attacks give 1 under AI rule flag 0x09e03070 & 4 and 0 for an attacker with a 0x1cd1 link whose ATK is below the working plan's opponent LP (0x09e276f8) when 0x1cd1 finds no target; attacks on monsters give 0 with effects 0x1893 or 0x1a13. Effect 0x1f1b or a negated attacker give 1. Per-card rules on the attacker: 0x1cd3, 0x1b8c (needs 0x1102, 0x175e with race 0x11, or 0x17fe), 0x1a55 (Roids), 0x19d2, 0x19bd, 0x1770, 0x1476, 0x1370, 0x1286 (0), 0x1b40, 0x16bf, 0x1bb5, 0x182d (1), 0x1acf (1 with two face-up Elemental HEROs), 0x14d7 (0 against Defense Position), 0x1115 (0 with flag when own LP > 4000), 0x15fb in hand or field (1) for 0x1cab and 8 battle-trigger ids; finally, for an attack on a monster by an attacker with snapshot ATK >= 1900, 1 when ATK minus the target's ATK reaches the opponent's planned LP, 0 when the opponent has more monsters and the target's ATK is 1001-1799, and 0 against a Defense Position target with DEF < 1900. Returns 1 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_attack_target).

column2: int ai_review_battle_plan(int side, int only_slot, int optional_only)
column3: Reviews the working plan 0x09e276e4 after its attacks were simulated and flags risky attacks for re-planning. Returns 1 (keep) when no attacker is planned (record 0 +2, 0x09e2782a, is 0) or the plan wins the duel (+0x22). Otherwise X = the opponent's best snapshot ATK (ai_find_best_sim_attacker_slot), skipping monsters made harmless by an opposing 0x1eaf and the attackers taken by own 0x1842 links; planned attackers with effect value 0x18e5 >= 2 raise X, and a planned 0x1502 with damage returns 1; own 0x1ec3 in Defense Position with DEF >= X, own 0x1cd4/0x1b9c with ATK > X, or the opponent's 0x1eda with race-0xd Graveyard cards return 1; 0x1ba3 and 0x140c copies give spare attacks, 0x1e37 marks the other slots, 0x1e3c changes the destruction test. It then rebuilds the post-battle board from the newest snapshot slot (depth 0x09e27fee; 0x09e03f7c + (depth - 1) * 0x39f8 + side * 0xb3c + slot * 0x14) for destroyed attackers (entry +8), destroyed targets (entry +4), entry +0x14 masks and the plan's +0x1a mask, sets 0x09e28638 = 1, and walks the attack-order records (0x09e27828 + i * 0x10: +0, +2 attacker + 1, +4 target, +0xa, +0xc): for each planned attack (only_slot < 0 or that slot; with optional_only only when duel_core_is_attack_optional) it flags the attack in 0x09e27ff4 (bit target + attacker * 6) and returns 0 when the record's +0xc is set while the cached dominance (0x09e28008 + side * 0x30c) is not better and not positive, or when ai_check_slot_battle_risk(side, slot, ATK, DEF, target, max(X, 1200), own LP or 1000) reports a risk and no spare attack is left (ATK/DEF swapped under effect 0x19f1 kind 2 or 0x1f24). Destroyed monsters are cleared again (ai_sim_clear_slot_card, or the 0xeb8 record value zeroed). Restores 0x09e28638. Returns 1 or 0. Side effects: 0x09e27ff4, the simulated board slots. Callers: 2 (ai_plan_battle_with_summoned_monster, ai_plan_battle).

column2: int ai_get_effective_attack_vs_target(int side, int slot, int target)
column3: ATK of side's slot (stat snapshot +0x18) as it would count against target: 200 when the target (0-4) has slot flag bit 10 set, is not negated and is card 0x1621. When the attacker is not negated: against a monster target with flag bit 10, attribute bonuses (0x1d76 +700 and 0x1d75 +200 against attribute 1, 0x1b72 +1000 against 3, 0x17ed +1000 against 1, 0x1397 +500 against 2, 0x1184 +1000 against 6); then 0x1b40 gives 0 against a Fusion, 0x1aef +500 against the opposite column (slot == 4 - target), 0x1e8e and 0x1da7 +300, 0x1d09 and 0x1ba4 +400, 0x1a7a +200 per target Level, 0x18f2 +500, 0x1508 +1000; for a direct attack (target >= 5) 0x1952 +500 and 0x1507 +1000. A target 0x1b40 (flag bit 10, not negated) gives 0 against a Fusion attacker. Returns the value. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_is_better_attack_result).

column2: bool ai_is_better_attack_result(int side, void *candidate, void *best, int flag)
column3: Compares two 68-byte attack results for side's attack: true when candidate is better than best. A higher u16 +2 (attack rating) wins, a lower one loses. On equal ratings: at rating 5, a candidate whose damage words (+0x20 + 0x24 of the opponent's block) reach the planned opponent LP 0x09e276f8 while dealing less, or that leaves the opponent fewer cards (+0x18) than the plan's deck word 0x09e27702, wins; then it counts the own monsters each result destroys (bits side * 5 + slot of +0xe, plus the attacker), prefers attacking a target that is not face-down-flagged (slot flag bit 10) and compares ai_get_effective_attack_vs_target (below 2001) when both target monsters; when one attacks directly while the opponent still holds hand cards and no field cards, the larger opponent damage wins; same attacker or both attackers destroyed with the candidate's ATK not lower: a higher u16 +6 loses, equal +6 = 0 with larger own loss words loses; fewer own monsters destroyed wins; then smaller own losses (+0x20 + 0x24 + 0x28), larger opponent losses, face-down target preferences by DEF, and with flag a larger opponent damage. Returns the decision. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ai_choose_best_attack, ai_choose_attack_target).

column2: bool ai_choose_attack_target(int side, int slot, int precheck_flag, short *result, int simulate)
column3: Chooses the target of side's monster in slot and fills result (68-byte attack result, initialised by ai_init_attack_result(result, side, slot, 5)). The direct attack is tried first when the monster can attack directly or has a direct-attack mode and the pair is not flagged in 0x09e27ff4 (bit slot * 6 + 5); then the opponent's monster zones from a random start (duel_core_random(5)) that duel_core_is_valid_attack_target(side, slot, opponent, t, 1) accepts and that are not flagged. Unless simulate, each must pass ai_precheck_attack_target(side, slot, t, precheck_flag); each is evaluated with ai_eval_attack(side, slot, t, simulate, &tmp) and kept when it is the first one (simulate) or ai_is_better_attack_result says it is better, together with a copy of the working plan state (header 0x09e276e4-0x09e27707, attack entries 0x09e27708, extra entries 0x09e277a8, attack-order records 0x09e27828). When the opponent has 0x139c active and not every valid target got a non-zero rating (+2), the rating is cleared. The saved plan state of the chosen attack is written back. Returns true when simulate is set or the chosen rating (result +2) is non-zero. Side effects: result, the working battle plan. Callers: 2 (ai_choose_best_attack, ai_simulate_attack).

column2: int ai_collect_attackers(int side, int unused_arg, int *out_slots)
column3: Lists side's monster slots 0-4 that can declare an attack (duel_core_can_declare_attack) in out_slots and sorts them (selection sort) by ascending key (priority << 16) | ATK, with ATK from the stat snapshot (capped at 0xffff). Priority starts at 0x14; 0x13 when the attacker wins against some opposing monster by a card rule (bit 0 of ai_sim_resolve_battle on snapshot copies). Unless negated, about 120 card rules adjust it: +1..+3 for cards that should attack later (0x18a4, 0x12a0, 0x128f, 0x11cd, 0x19cf, 0x1db6 group, 0x1f39 group, 0x1bc0, 0x1bbf, 0x16bf), -2..-5 for battle-trigger cards that should attack first (a list of about 70 ids, 0x1edb, 0x1ea2 group, 0x1e21/0x1e1d/0x1d8c with several attackers, 0x1e92, 0x1a4e, 0x19c1, 0x186c, 0x1e50, ...), -4 for effect 0x1f1b, -5 for a 0x1cb7 masquerade. 0x1237 link sources add +-4 by comparing the LPs, direct attackers (with opposing monsters) get -6, piercing -3 with the ATK part inverted. Returns the number of attackers. Side effects: writes out_slots. The second argument is not read. Callers: 3 (ai_choose_best_attack, ai_handler_on_attack_declared_event, ai_has_better_mass_attack_trap); exported (2 import stubs without callers).

Chooses side's next attack for the simulated battle and stores its 68-byte attack result at 0x09e27f90 (initialised by ai_init_attack_result(0x09e27f90, side, 5, 5)). Attackers come from ai_collect_attackers (0 when there are none). Before choosing, every active 0x18e5 attacker (no control-change lock, a free monster zone) takes a target with ai_choose_target_with_temp_link and copies that monster's id, ATK and DEF into its own stat snapshot record (+0x04, +0x18, +0x1c), wipes the target slot (ai_sim_wipe_slot) and attaches a kind-1 effect 0x18e5. With 0x1328 in hand or on the field the attackers are sorted by equip count, and an attacker with effect 0x1bdd value 1 goes first. Each attacker's best target (ai_choose_attack_target(side, slot, 1, tmp, 0)) replaces 0x09e27f90 when ai_is_better_attack_result(side, tmp, 0x09e27f90, mode) says so; unless 0x1469 is active or the opponent has exactly one non-0x1d69 Attack Position monster beside Defense Position ones, it returns 1 at once for the last attacker or for a rating > 2 against a flagged (slot flag bit 10) monster when the rating is 5 or side loses nothing. Returns 1 when a result with a non-zero rating (0x09e27f92) was found; otherwise, with mode > 0 and no planned attacker (0x09e2782a == 0), it forces an attack with 0x09e28638 = 1 (mandatory attackers first, then from the last attacker down, ai_choose_attack_target with simulate 1) and returns 1 when one is found, else 0. Side effects: 0x09e27f90, stat snapshot, simulated board, effects attached, the working plan (through ai_choose_attack_target). Callers: 1 (ai_plan_simulate_attacks).

Attaches the snapshot markers that let the AI undo effects added during a simulation: for every occupied monster zone of both sides a kind-2 effect with key 0xff and value side | slot << 8 (duel_core_attach_effect), and one for each side's hand slot 0xb (value side | 0xb00); a 0x1cb1 monster without a kind < 6 effect 0x1cb1 after its first 0xff marker also gets a kind-2 effect 0x1cb1 worth 500 x min(Deck count, 3). With check non-zero it first returns 0 without changes when a monster already has a 0xff marker for the current snapshot depth (0x09e27fee; markers counted along the slot's effect list, head at slot +0x0a, pool 0x09e2c7cc with 10-byte entries: +0 key, +2 kind in the low 4 bits, +8 next). Returns 1 after marking. Side effects: effect pool entries. Callers: 8 (ai_push_state_snapshot, ai_simulate_attack, ai_plan_battle_with_tricks, ai_plan_battle, ...).

Undoes the effects attached since the current snapshot (depth 0x09e27fee): for every occupied monster zone of both sides whose slot flag bit 29 is clear, and for each side's hand-slot list (player block +0x11a), it finds the 0xff marker belonging to that depth in the effect list (pool 0x09e2c7cc, 10-byte entries, next index at +8) and detaches it and every later entry (duel_core_detach_effect); finally every remaining pool entry 1-255 whose key is 0xff is detached together with its followers. No return value. Side effects: effect pool. Callers: 1 (ai_eval_attack).

column2: int ai_sim_apply_summon_effect(void *link, int side, int slot, uint card, uint mask, int ref, uint source, int count)
column3: Simulates the effect of a monster just placed by the AI simulation, or one primitive action when card is an opcode 1-8 (the function recurses into itself). Opcodes: 1 choose up to count targets of link in mask (ai_choose_target_as_controller) and wipe the opposing ones; 2 the same with costs (ai_choose_cost_as_side), 0 when a choice fails; 3 wipe every slot 0-10 in mask (0 for an empty mask); 4 repeatedly pair a target with a cost from mask and wipe both; 5 wipe the monster slots in mask and simulate summoning card slot (here a card id) with ai_sim_resolve_card_with_temp_link(side, -1, slot, ref, count, 0, 0, source, 1); 6 the best hand monster (ai_choose_hand_monster_by_stats with duel_effects_select_filter_hand_candidate) through opcode 5; 7 the candidate of ai_try_choose_candidates(side, 6, source, 0, 0) through opcode 5; 8 (no control-change lock) move the slot chosen by ai_choose_hand_card_as_side into a free monster zone. For about 60 card ids (Synchro checks use card_db_get_frame == 10 and source == card) it attaches the effect the card would create (kinds 2, 3, 0x12, 0x16, 0x17, e.g. 0x1f22 +500 per target, 0x1edb +200 per Iron Chain in the Graveyard, 0x1ed6 +400 and 0x1ec9 +800 per hand candidate, 0x1e10 the ATK of low-Level monsters, 0x1cb7 the best Graveyard ATK, counters for 0x1c62 and 0x1b10, phase-dependent 0x13a6) or calls an opcode with ai_get_target_mask(link) (destruction, costs, summons of 0xf69 or 0x1e18/0x1e19 pairs, position change of 0x1d78's target), usually only when side is the turn player 0x09e2d1d8; the link's handler selector (+3 bits 4-5) is set to 1 first. Returns 1, or the opcode's result. Side effects: simulated board (wiped and moved slots, attached effects), link +3. Callers: 2 (ai_sim_apply_summon_effect, ai_sim_resolve_card_with_temp_link).

column2: int ai_sim_resolve_card_with_temp_link(int side, int summon_side, uint card, int ref, int position, int count, ushort *material_refs, uint source, int extra_attack)
column3: Simulates side Special Summoning card (instance ref, position) because of source, with count materials material_refs. summon_side < 0 means side, or the opponent for source cards that summon to the other field (0x1ef3 with 0xf6d, 0x1ee0 with 0xf6c, 0x1ec0, 0x1e85, 0x1d9a, 0x1a92, 0x1578, 0x1cda) unless the control-change lock 0x09e03070 & 0x80 is set. It turns the chain entry 0x09e28cb4 + 0x09e28e38 * 0x18 into a temporary link (card, owner, selector 3; saved and restored) made current (0x09e28e44), forces the recursion counter 0x09e28f80 negative, handles Synchro 0x1e10 with a set 0x1e4a, then reads and wipes each material slot, computing a value from them (Iron Chains for 0x1edb, race 1 for 0x1ed8, Lightsworn for 0x1dad, the 0x1807 group bits for 0x1b15/0x1b14, attribute matches, ATK sums for 0x1cec/0x1654/0x1388 and double for 0x1688) and remembering up to 8 material effects (kind 3, key 0x1e11) for Synchro summons; some cards take the value from the summon record words 0x09e290c2/0x09e290c8/0x09e29058/0x09e29060. It then calls ai_sim_summon_monster(summon_side, card, ref, 1, position, value, source, extra_attack); on success it updates the link slot, applies a face-up 0x1ee0 (half ATK and a 0xf6c token), ai_sim_apply_summon_effect(link, summon_side, slot, card, 0, count, source, 0), and when extra_attack is 0 the set 0x1e56 reaction for race-0x13 monsters, 0x1ed0 for Iron Chains and the Psychic boost (ai_eval_power_injector, ai_sim_boost_all_psychics) when source is 0; about 20 source cards add their own follow-ups (0x15b3 moves the monster into a spell/trap zone as an equip, 0x1a0c with 0x1a05 summons the candidates of ai_try_choose_candidates kind 0x29 recursively, 0x1678 a cost, 0x1cad slot flag bit 14, 0x1aca/0x1809/0x172f/0x1636/0x1472 the material's location in slot +0x0c and flag bit 12, ...). Finally attaches the remembered material effects (duel_core_attach_instance_effect), a 0x1eb9 effect for Synchro monsters marked by 0x1eb9 when side's LP exceeds its amount, restores the link, 0x09e28e44 and 0x09e28f80, and stores summon_side in 0x09e03081 (ai_summon_choice +0x01). Returns the slot, or a negative value when no zone was found. Side effects: simulated board, effect pool, 0x09e03081, summon record words for 0x1d62. Callers: 5 (ai_sim_summon_card_to_field, ai_should_summon_in_defense, ai_plan_prepare_attack_state, ai_sim_apply_summon_effect, ...).

column2: int ai_sim_gemini_summon_slot(int side, int slot, ushort position)
column3: Simulation step of a Gemini (second) summon of the monster already in side's monster zone slot (0-4): with a visible card there it saves the 24-byte link at the chain top (0x09e28cb4 + 0x09e28e38 * 0x18) and makes it a temporary link for that card (owner, slot, +3 bits 4-5 = 3, instance field from slot +0x35/+0x36), points the current link 0x09e28e44 at it and forces AI-evaluation mode 0x09e28f80 = -1, sets bit 0x4000 of the slot flag word (+0x44, 0x09e2a56c + side * 0xb3c + slot * 0x14) and writes position to the slot position word (+0x3a). Card-specific effects: for 0x1db0 it asks ai_choose_target_as_controller for a target and wipes that slot (ai_sim_wipe_slot), or attaches effect (kind 3, key 0, value 1) to the monster when there is none; for 0x1d04, when side has Graveyard monsters of attribute 2, it wipes the chosen target. Restores the link, 0x09e28e44 and 0x09e28f80. Returns slot, or -1 for a slot outside 0-4 or an empty slot. Side effects: writes the simulated slot (flag bit 0x4000, position), may wipe a target slot or attach an effect (meant for use inside a state snapshot). Callers: 1 (ai_plan_battle_with_gemini_summon).

column2: void ai_plan_prepare_attack_state(int side, int reset_attacks, uint trick, int full, int simulate)
column3: Prepares the simulated board before ai_plan_simulate_attacks. With simulate set and (phase 0x09e2d1e8 != 3 or reset_attacks) it calls duel_core_init_battle_phase_attack_state(side, 3). For both sides' face-up monsters 0-4 it builds the plan's leave-the-field mask (plan +0x1a, 0x09e276fe, bit side * 5 + slot): nine self-destructing cards (0x1d12, 0x1c6b, 0x1c09, 0x1b4c-0x1b4e, 0x1a6d-0x1a6f) unless card 0x1a77 protects them or 0x1d17 is active on/held for them (0x1d12 and 0x1c09 also add every slot of their target mask from ai_get_card_target_mask(.., 2, 5)), and Spirit monsters with slot flag bit 16 or 17 when ai_get_spirit_return_mode(side). On the opponent's side it attaches simulated effects for 0x1f0a (when side has a monster with flag bit 16) and for trick 0x12cb. On side's own monsters, when simulate is set, a face-down or Defense Position monster that may change position (reset_attacks or ai_get_position_change_level, flip allowed: duel_core_can_flip_summon, not ai_wants_set_flip_monster, ai_allows_summon_mode_20, not ai_is_slot_blocked_by_level_lock) is put in Attack Position, flipped face-up (flags 0x20000 and 0x80000, face-up word 1) with flip effects of 0x1ec0, 0x1527, 0x1d7a, 0x13ad simulated; trick 0x1409 attaches ATK / 5 to each face-up race-7 monster, trick 0x12cb attaches to face-up monsters (not to a flipped one whose DEF <= ATK). Then (simulate) 0x1f24 gains effect 0x1f24 when another face-up level < 5 Genex is present and its ATK and original ATK are below DEF (detached again if it still cannot attack), 0x1f08 gains effect 0x1f08 when the trick is a spell; trick 0xeab attaches kind 4 to the target ai_choose_target_with_temp_link picks. No return value. Side effects: writes plan +0x1a, slot position/face-up/flag words and attaches duel_core effects on the (snapshotted) board. Callers: 3 (ai_sim_summon_card_to_field, ai_plan_battle_with_summoned_monster, ai_build_battle_plan).

Plays out side's attacks on the simulated board and fills the working battle plan 0x09e276e4. ai_sim_prepare_battle_stats(side), then while ai_choose_best_attack(side, mode) returns non-zero and the plan has not won: reads the 68-byte attack result 0x09e27f90 (per-side blocks at +0x14 + side * 0x18: +0x14 slot, +0x18 deck loss, +0x20 battle damage, +0x24 effect LP loss, +0x28 score; +0x0e destroyed mask, +0x10 value word 0x09e27fa0), sets the attacker's attacked flag (slot +0x44 bit 22, or bit 23 when 22 is set), applies some 40 attacker/defender card cases (value adjustments of +0x10 such as -400, -500, +200, +3000, simulated effects attached through duel_core_attach_effect, position flips, follow-up summons queued in a local list of up to 4 per side and later placed with ai_sim_summon_monster, card 0x1818 set trap summons), writes the attack entry (+0x0e target, +0x02 attacks, +0x18 damage, +0x1c score), subtracts LP from plan +0x10/+0x14 and deck counts from +0x1c/+0x1e, sets +0x22 when the opponent's LP or deck (while it had cards) drop below 1, fills the next attack-order record at plan +0x144 (class, attacker + 1, target, target destroyed, extra-entry index), and clears destroyed monsters with ai_sim_clear_slot_card (unless card 0xeb8 is active and the monster has counters of type 0x13) counting own (+0x00, entry +0x08) and opposing (+0x02, entry +0x04, +0x06, +0x0a) losses; the stat snapshot is rebuilt after each attack. Afterwards it restores the first attack result into 0x09e27f90, adds each attacker's value word to its snapshot ATK, restores the attacked flags, detaches the temporary simulated effects of this snapshot depth, clears the monsters of the leave-the-field mask +0x1a unless the plan won (else zeroes the mask), and writes +0x04/+0x06 monster counts, +0x08 total damage, +0x0c total score and +0x18 ai_eval_battle_dominance(side, 0, 1). Returns the total damage (+0x08). Side effects: writes the working plan, the attack result, the stat snapshot and the simulated duel state (run inside a snapshot). Callers: 1 (ai_build_battle_plan).

column2: int ai_build_battle_plan(int side, int mode, void *from_plan, ushort trick, int simulate, int reset_attacks)
column3: Builds one battle plan (0x2e4-byte working plan 0x09e276e4). When reset_attacks is set, or mode is -1 for the turn player 0x09e2d1d8 before the Battle Phase (phase 0x09e2d1e8, or the saved phase 0x09e27fe4 while the phase stack 0x09e27fec is in use, < 3), it clears the attacked flags (bits 22-23 of +0x44) of side's five monster slots; in the Battle Phase with mode -1 only those of the current attacker (0x09e2863c of side 0x09e28620). Then ai_plan_init(side, mode == -1, from_plan, trick); if the plan's own LP (+0x10) > 0, own deck (+0x1c) >= 0 and duel_core_can_enter_battle_phase(side), it runs ai_plan_prepare_attack_state(side, reset_attacks, trick, mode == -1, simulate), pushes the phase on the 4-entry stack 0x09e27fe4 and forces phase 3, runs ai_plan_simulate_attacks(side, mode) and pops the phase. Clears 0x09e27ff2 when mode is -1. Returns the planned damage, or 0 when no battle is possible. Side effects: writes the working plan, the phase word (temporarily) and the simulated board. Callers: 3 (ai_plan_battle_with_summoned_monster, ai_plan_battle_with_tricks, ai_plan_battle).

column2: int ai_plan_battle_with_tricks(int side, int mode, void *from_plan, int simulate, int reset_attacks)
column3: Pushes a state snapshot (depth 0x09e27fee < 10: 0xc14 bytes of 0x09e29914 and 0x2de4 bytes of 0x09e2a528 into slot 0x09dff93c + n * 0x39f8, then ai_mark_monsters_for_snapshot(0) and duel_effects_update_negated_slots(1)) and builds the base plan with ai_build_battle_plan(side, mode, from_plan, 0, simulate, reset_attacks). When the combat-trick list 0x09e27ff8 is not empty it saves the plan (header 0x24 bytes, attack entries 0x09e27708, extra entries 0x09e277a8, attack-order records 0x09e27828) and the simulated board (player blocks 0x09e2a528 for 0x1678 bytes, 0x09e2bba0, the effect lists 0x09e2bbcc and 0x09e2c7cc) as the best result, then for each trick ai_get_combat_trick(i) restores the snapshot (pop and re-push, with ai_analyze_board of the view side), rebuilds the plan with that trick and keeps it (plan and board) when ai_compare_plans(new, best) & mask is non-zero, mask 0x10 for trick 0x1409 and 0x1e otherwise; finally the best plan and its board are written back. The snapshot pushed on entry is not popped here (callers pop it). Returns the plan value (+0x08, 0x09e276ec). Side effects: writes the working plan 0x09e276e4, the simulated duel state and the snapshot stack. Callers: 4 (ai_should_summon_in_defense, ai_plan_battle_with_gemini_summon, ai_plan_battle_with_summoned_monster, ai_plan_battle).

column2: void ai_plan_battle(int side, int mode, int simulate)
column3: Full battle planning for side with the view side 0x09e02ffa temporarily set to side: resets the attack entries' slot words (5 entries and the 4 extra entries 0x09e277a8.. to 0xffff) and the flagged-target mask 0x09e27ff4, then loops: push a snapshot, run ai_plan_battle_with_tricks(side, mode, 0, simulate, mode == -2) (rule flag 0x09e03070 bit 2 set during the first pass only), and ai_review_battle_plan(side, -1, mode). When the review accepts and mode is -1 it sets the plan-valid flag 0x09e27ff0 = 1 and copies the working plan (0x2e4 bytes) to the side's saved plan 0x09e279c8 + side * 0x2e4; when side is the AI side 0x09e02ff8 it also plans the opponent's reply: view = opponent, ai_sim_summon_monster(opponent, 0x129f, -1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0) (a stand-in monster, hypothesis, confidence medium), bit 2 set, ai_build_battle_plan(opponent, 1, saved plan of side, 0, 1, 1), result copied to the opponent's saved plan, and the side's plan copied back to the working plan. It pops two snapshots per pass (its own and the one left by ai_plan_battle_with_tricks) and repeats until the review accepts. Restores the view side. No return value. Side effects: writes the working and saved plans, 0x09e27ff0, 0x09e27ff4, 0x09e03070 bit 2 and re-runs ai_analyze_board on each pop. AI handler for card 0x138f: refuses when ai_rate_lp_gain(ctx side, card) is 0, or when the side's saved battle plan (0x09e279c8 + side * 0x2e4) has another monster (not the current attacker 0x09e2863c) planning a direct attack (entry +0x0e > 4) whose damage (+0x18) exceeds the u16 at ctx +0x14. Otherwise accepts when the rating is >= 2, the side's LP is <= 1,500, or ctx +0x14 is >= 1,500. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x132d: while 0x1539 is active on ctx's side it accepts in the opponent's End Phase (turn player != side, phase 0x09e2d1e8 == 5) or in its own turn before phase 2. When ctx's side owns 0x1468 it also accepts, in phase 5, an opposing spell/trap-zone target (slots 5-10) whose slot flag word +0x44 has bit 10 clear and bit 20 set. Finally it accepts when any target in the spell/trap zones (5-10) of either side has ai_rate_slot_threat(side, slot, card) == 2. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x14aa: counts the spells among the opposing slots 0-10 in the target filter mask and accepts when ai_eval_damage_effect(ctx, count * 500, 0) is 1 (lethal). Refuses when the controller's battle dominance is > 0 unless it is the opponent's Battle Phase (phase 3). Otherwise accepts when a filtered target in the spell/trap zones (5-10) of either side has ai_rate_slot_threat == 2. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1718: estimates the LP change of both sides (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0)). Accepts when the effect hurts the opponent during the Battle Phase and the simulated current attack (ai_sim_current_attack on the target 0x09e28624/0x09e28640) deals at least the target side's LP. Refuses when the effect would kill its own side; accepts when it kills the opponent; otherwise accepts only with at least 3 own monsters and a chosen target (ai_choose_target_as_controller) whose ATK differs from the side's best attacker ATK. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1c9e: same LP guard as ai_handler_check_lp_1718 (ai_estimate_lp_change; accept when an opponent-hurting effect plus the current simulated attack reaches the target side's LP in the Battle Phase; refuse when it kills the own side; accept when it kills the opponent), otherwise ai_cond_has_target(ctx, arg). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1301: requires the estimated LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change) to hurt the opponent without killing the controller; when it kills the opponent it accepts. Otherwise, with a link: response mode 0x09e0307c 1 needs the link to be the controller's own with a non-zero ai_classify_resolve_kind, mode 0 needs the link to be the controller's own, other modes refuse; when that test passes it accepts if the opponent has at least 2 monsters, when it fails it accepts if ai_is_card_threatened_by_chain(ctx, link). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x135c and 0x1635: counts visible effect monsters on both fields (n); when n > 0 it presets the LP change (0x135c: opponent -500 * n, 0x1635: controller +400 * n), runs ai_estimate_lp_change and refuses when the controller would die, accepts when the opponent would. Then refuses when the controller has a face-down monster that ai_wants_set_when_attacked, and accepts when the opponent has a face-down monster. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x12cd: walks the timing-event queue (count 0x09e28f98, codes 0x09e28fa0[i], entries 0x09e28fc0 + 4 * i) for summon events (codes 6, 7, 8) and accepts when the event's monster (entry byte +1: side bit 1, slot bits 2-5) is on the other side, face-up, targetable by ctx (duel_effects_can_target_slot), has ATK <= 2,000 and its controller's deck still holds a card of the same name. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x1518 and 0x16e0: returns 0 when the timing-event queue (0x09e28f98 entries, codes 0x09e28fa0) holds a summon event (codes 6, 7, 8) whose controller (entry byte +1 bit 1 xor byte +2 bit 0) is ctx's controller, otherwise 1. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Checks the queued summon events (codes 0x20, 0x21, 0x22 in the timing-event queue 0x09e28fa0, count 0x09e28f98; card from the instance table 0x09e2bbcc via the entry's ref) for a response to them. Returns 0 when link is non-null, when an event's controller is ctx's controller, or when a code-0x22 event is card 0x1be9 that can still be sent to the Graveyard. With min_atk 0 it then returns 1; otherwise 1 only when an event monster summoned by the other side has genre 10 or an estimated ATK (ai_estimate_off_field_atk) >= min_atk. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ai_handler_check_battle_1ce5, ai_handler_counter_harmful_link_12fd, ai_handler_chain_negate_summon).

AI handler for card 0x12e7: takes the highest ATK or DEF among ctx's own monsters (slots 0-4, duel_core_get_atk/get_def) and accepts when an opposing face-up monster in the target mask has a higher ATK. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1d1e: in the opponent's End Phase (turn player != ctx side, phase 5) accepts when the controller's hand holds a monster without genre 0x15, of attribute 2 and level > 4 (duel_core_get_level_by_ref). Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x12f3: only outside a chain response (link null) and on the opponent's turn. For event code 0x17, or codes 0x12/0x13 when the attack is direct (target slot 0x09e28640 >= 5) or the attacker's ATK beats the target (ATK >= target ATK in Attack Position, ATK > target DEF in Defense Position), it accepts when ai_choose_summon_from_hand(ctx, 0, 1) finds a summon. Side effects: through ai_choose_summon_from_hand (summon choice 0x09e03080). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x175a: only in ctx side's own turn for event code 1. Sums the positive upkeep LP changes of every visible card on both fields (ai_estimate_slot_upkeep_lp_change(view side, side, slot, 0)) and tracks the largest visible ATK/DEF among those that are targets; accepts at once when an own target carries effect 0x1d1b. Then returns 0 when the total is below the own LP, 1 when the total minus that largest stat is below it, else 0 (literal reading; comparing an LP total with a stat looks unintended, confidence medium). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x137e: in ctx side's own turn for event code 1, with bit 23 of the side's player word +0x120 clear and the card not already applied to the side (duel_core_slot_has_effect(side, 11, card) == 0), accepts when any visible card on either field has a positive upkeep LP change (ai_estimate_slot_upkeep_lp_change) or an own card carries effect 0x1d1b. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1490: with n monsters in ctx side's Graveyard (n > 0), accepts when an opposing face-up monster has a non-zero level <= n. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x14f0: with g = the opponent's Graveyard count (player block +0x14) it accepts when the side would deck out drawing 4 (ai_would_deck_out) and its deck (+0x10) is smaller than the opponent's; otherwise it needs g below the opponent's deck count and below the side's own Graveyard count, and then accepts when g is 0 or the side holds no 0x12f9 in hand or on the field. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1359: requires ai_cond_has_candidate(ctx). Accepts when the controller does not own 0xfb7 or field slot 10 does not hold an active 0xeb7; otherwise counts which of the five cards 0xfb7-0xfbb are in hand (n) and accepts only when n >= 2, ai_count_forbidden_one_pieces_in_graveyard >= 1 and their sum is 5. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Shared-style AI handler (named, not per card) for effects that return a monster face-down: only without a link. For each own face-up flip monster (card_db_get_flip_kind != 0) in the target mask it temporarily marks the slot face-down; in the controller's own turn before phase 3, with ai_get_position_change_level, duel_core_can_flip_summon_slot and ai_eval_flip_effect(side, slot, 0) all true, it restores the face-up word and accepts. Otherwise it restores the face-up word and, for a monster with ATK < 1,001, accepts on the opponent's turn, or on its own turn from phase 4 on or when ctx's card is 0x1e48. Returns 1 or 0. No lasting side effects. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

AI handler for cards 0x15a8 and 0x1887: requires ai_cond_can_discard(ctx) and a target chosen by ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, target mask, 1); accepts when the target is on ctx's own side, when ai_rate_slot_threat(target, card, card == 0x15a8) is 2, or when the side's battle dominance is negative. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x19db: requires ai_cond_can_discard(ctx) and an opposing target chosen by ai_choose_target_as_controller (own-side targets refuse); accepts when the target is ai_is_valuable_effect_card or the side's battle dominance is negative. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x15f0: refuses when 0x1102 is active on ctx's side, 0x1400 is active anywhere, or the opponent's player-level effects (slot 11) include 0x16a1 or 0x1886; otherwise accepts when ai_is_not_applied_to_opponent(ctx) and the side's battle dominance is negative. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x16a1: refuses when 0x1102 is active on ctx's side, 0x1400 is active anywhere, or the opponent's player-level effects (slot 11) include 0x15f0 or 0x1886; otherwise returns ai_is_not_applied_to_opponent(ctx). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1886: requires ai_is_not_applied_to_opponent(ctx); accepts when ai_is_card_threatened_by_chain(ctx, link); otherwise, only for event code 3, refuses when 0x1102 is active on ctx's side, 0x1400 anywhere, or the opponent has player-level effect 0x15f0 or 0x16a1, and accepts when the opponent has a face-up Attack Position monster. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x12d6: chooses a cost slot with ai_choose_cost_for_current_link(controller, card, target mask without ctx's own slot (ctx +0x15: side bit 1, slot bits 2-5), 1) and requires ai_cond_can_choose_candidate(ctx); it then puts the selected candidate's card into that slot (ai_sim_set_slot_card, duel_effects_update_negated_slots), accepts when ai_eval_battle_dominance(controller, ctx's slot bit) exceeds the cached dominance (board view 0x09e28008 + controller * 0x30c), and restores the slot. Side effects: none lasting (sets the dominance-stale flag 0x09e03070 bit 0x20 through ai_sim_set_slot_card). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1eee: requires the opponent to be able to enter the Battle Phase; with L = ai_get_lowest_battle_stat(controller, -1) it refuses when an opposing face-up monster that can attack (ai_can_slot_attack) has ATK > L, sums L - ATK over those monsters, and accepts when the sum reaches the opponent's LP or exceeds 999. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1e51: requires the current attacker (0x09e28620 / 0x09e2863c) to be in the target mask; accepts when ai_handler_gain_lp(ctx, link) does, otherwise presets the controller's LP change to the attacker's ATK (0 when face-down), runs ai_estimate_lp_change and accepts when the controller survives. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1a9b: with ai_cond_can_discard(ctx), accepts when ctx side's Graveyard (list player block +0x55c, count +0x14) holds a race-9 card with ATK > 2,499. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x1c40 and 0x1c41: needs a link of ctx's own controller whose card icon (card_db_get_icon) is not 2, 3 or 4, then returns ai_cond_can_discard(ctx). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x1973 and 0x172f: refuses on ctx side's own turn and inside a chain response; 0x172f also needs ai_handler_special_summon(ctx, 0). For event codes 0x12/0x13 it returns the word 0x09e28628 (attack state of the current battle, meaning open), otherwise whether the phase is 5. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1bfb: on ctx side's own turn with ai_can_controller_enter_battle(ctx), accepts unless ai_estimate_off_field_atk(side, 0x19fd) + 1,000 is below the value returned by ai_find_best_monster_slot(opponent, 0, 1, 0); otherwise accepts when the opponent's saved plan value (+0x08 of 0x09e279c8 + opponent * 0x2e4) reaches the side's LP. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x195e: finds the extreme-stat target (duel_effects_find_extreme_stat_target(ctx, &slot), returns a value); refuses with no target, a value < 1 or a target unaffected by ctx; otherwise writes the value into ctx +8 (u16) and returns ai_eval_damage_effect(ctx, 0, 0), replacing a negative result by 1 when the target is on the controller's opponent's side, else 0. Side effects: writes ctx +8. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1468: requires ai_cond_no_active_copy(ctx); in the opponent's End Phase (turn player != ctx side, phase 5) accepts when each of the cards 0x1497, 0x1498, 0x1499 and 0x149a is in the side's hand or deck. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Decides whether a card that negates or stops the current attack should be used. Refuses for a link of card 0x1ec5. Card gates: 0x1ef6 needs ai_handler_check_targets_1668, 0x195f a face-up Elemental Hero and ai_cond_opponent_has_target, 0x1678 an opposing target with filter duel_effects_target_filter_1878, others except 0x1c0a ai_cond_opponent_has_target. Then, when the attacker (0x09e28620 / 0x09e2863c) is not unaffected by ctx, simulates the attack (ai_sim_current_attack on the target, flags out): accepts when the result is >= 1 or flag bit 0 is set, otherwise only when a link of ctx's opponent is being answered. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ai_handler_on_attack_declared_event, ai_try_location_cards).

Decides whether to use an attack-stopping card against the opponent's current attack (attacker side 0x09e28620 must be ctx side's opponent). Except for card 0x1908, refuses when the side has player-level effects 0x1316, 0x1805 or 0x1d3b. Accepts when the attacker's saved plan wins the duel (+0x22). Otherwise simulates the attack (ai_sim_current_attack): without flag bit 0 it accepts only when ai_has_better_mass_attack_trap(side, opponent, 2, card) is true; with it, card 0x1381 re-simulates with the attacker's ATK halved and accepts when that clears the flag or lowers the result, other cards accept. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ai_handler_on_attack_declared_event, ai_try_location_cards, ai_handler_on_damage_step_event).

column2: int ai_should_target_current_attacker(void *ctx, int arg, uint mask)
column3: Decides whether to use a card that targets the opponent's current attacker (must be ctx side's opponent and in mask). Sets ctx +3 bit 7 around the simulation of the attack (ai_sim_current_attack); refuses when it does no harm (result < 1 and flag bit 0 clear) or the attacker is unaffected by ctx. Accepts when the attacked monster is a battle stopper (ai_is_slot_battle_stopper) and flag bit 0 is set, or when the result reaches the side's LP. Card 0x1243 refuses a small result (< 700) outside event 0x14 against an Attack Position monster. When another opposing attacker is stronger (ai_get_best_attacker_atk excluding this one) it refuses; card rules: 0x1e54 only against a monster target and not the max-threat attacker, 0x1d27 needs ai_cond_can_discard, 0x1bda a monster target or ATK >= 1,800 and no better mass trap, 0x1b60 a hand spell to send, 0x1e0e/0x1d26/0x1ce8/0x16a7 no better mass trap (ai_has_better_mass_attack_trap), 0x1581 a monster target or ATK >= 1,000. Returns 1 or 0. Side effects: clears ctx +3 bit 7. Callers: 2 (ai_handler_on_attack_declared_event, ai_handler_on_damage_step_event).

column2: int ai_has_better_mass_attack_trap(int side, int attacker_side, int min_attackers, uint card)
column3: True when side holds a better answer to a mass attack than card: requires attacker_side's summed attacker ATK (ai_sum_attacker_atk) >= 3,000, rebuilds the stat snapshot (ai_sim_prepare_battle_stats(side)) and at least min_attackers attackers (ai_collect_attackers); then (card 0 or equal to the tested id) side has 0x1317 on its field, 0x1be1 with more than 2 attackers, 0x1c9d while the current attacker has counters of type 0xf, or 0x1dde when the attacked monster's name is a Frog. Returns 1 or 0. Side effects: rewrites the stat snapshot 0x09e0308c. Callers: 4 (ai_should_block_current_attack, ai_should_target_current_attacker, ai_choose_target_for_138d, ai_handler_on_attack_declared_event); exported (2 import stubs without callers).

column2: int ai_is_revive_response_worthwhile(void *ctx, uint card, int damage)
column3: Decides whether reviving or summoning card in response to an attack is worth it, with damage the expected battle damage. ATK = ai_estimate_off_field_atk_mode0(controller, card). For ctx card 0x1e43: accepts for card 0x1e24 when its LP amount is below damage and below the controller's LP. For ctx cards 0x1e4a, 0x1ddf, 0x1ddc, 0x1dd4, 0x1b65, 0x137d: accepts when ATK > 0 and damage would be lethal, or ATK >= damage. Otherwise accepts when damage is lethal or max(ATK, DEF) >= damage. Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_handler_on_attack_declared_event).

AI handler for card 0x1379: clears the AI scratch word 0x09e03068 and refuses when ctx side's LP <= 2,000 or when the response-mode test says the link is not to be answered (no link; mode 0x09e0307c 0 and the link is the controller's own; mode 1 and it is the controller's own with a non-zero ai_classify_resolve_kind). Accepts at once when a link target on the other side lies in location 0x0e with a spell card. Sets scratch bit 1 when the link affects players (duel_effects_get_affected_players, or link card 0x12c8), except for link cards 0x1d31 and a list of 12 others, 0x1be0 with fewer than 2 hand cards and 0x176c with fewer than 3; sets bit 0 when ai_is_card_threatened_by_chain(ctx, link). Accepts when the scratch word is non-zero and ai_cond_can_choose_candidate(ctx). Side effects: writes 0x09e03068 (bits 0-1), read by the activation code. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1f21: refuses when the response-mode test rejects the link (no link; mode 0x09e0307c 0 with a link of ctx's own controller; mode 1 with an own link whose ai_classify_resolve_kind is non-zero), otherwise accepts when ctx side would not deck out drawing 2 (ai_would_deck_out). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x1b90 and 0x1c87: refuses when the response-mode test rejects the link (no link, or an own link per mode 0x09e0307c); accepts when ai_cond_can_discard(ctx); otherwise accepts when one of the link's targets is ctx's own card (side and slot of ctx +2) or returns duel_effects_link_would_destroy_card(link). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x1d0a and 0x1ed5: refuses when the response-mode test rejects the link (no link; mode 0 with an own link; mode 1 with an own link of non-zero resolve kind) - the docs' example reading of this handler ("no link: yes") is inverted. Otherwise picks a slot with ai_choose_cost_for_current_link(side, card, target mask, 0): none refuses, an opposing slot accepts; for an own monster that can attack (ai_can_slot_attack) it refuses when that monster's visible battle stat exceeds the one of ctx's own slot (for 0x1ed5: of the link's first target); finally accepts when ai_eval_dominance_change(side, that slot, 1, 0) >= 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1d8f: requires ai_handler_counter_harmful_link(ctx, link) and the target-exception check on ai_classify_resolve_kind(link) (kinds 4/5: the link's filter matches more cards on ctx's side than ctx's own card; kinds 2/3 with one target: refuse when the target's visible card is 0x14de, 0x15f1, 0x1435, 0x12ff, 0x12fe or 0x10dd), then ai_cond_can_discard(ctx). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x14de: requires duel_effects_call_handler_0c(ctx, link) == 2, ai_handler_counter_harmful_link(ctx, link) and the target-exception check on ai_classify_resolve_kind(link) (kinds 4/5 need the link's filter to match more cards on ctx's side than ctx's own card; kinds 2/3 with one target refuse for targets 0x14de, 0x15f1, 0x1435, 0x12ff, 0x12fe, 0x10dd; other kinds accept). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1c96: requires ai_handler_counter_harmful_link(ctx, link); accepts when the link's card is a monster of attribute 1: in a monster zone (link slot < 5, duel_core_monster_has_attribute) or, in location 0x0e, a card that is neither spell nor trap with card_db attribute 1. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1c97: same as the 0x1c96 handler with attribute 2: requires ai_handler_counter_harmful_link(ctx, link) and the link's card to be a monster of attribute 2 in a monster zone, or a non-spell, non-trap card of attribute 2 in location 0x0e. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x12fd: on the opponent's turn accepts at once when ctx's side has a face-up 0x1499. When ai_is_not_spell_blocked_by_17a3(side, card) it refuses while the side's LP exceeds 3,000 (5,000 with 0x190a in hand). Without a link it returns ai_eval_pending_summon_events(ctx, 0, 0); with one it needs ai_handler_counter_harmful_link and the target-exception check (kinds 4/5 need more own matches than ctx's card; single targets 0x14de, 0x15f1, 0x1435, 0x12ff, 0x12fe, 0x10dd refuse). Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x19e1 and 0x19e2: refuses unless the timing-event queue is non-empty (0x09e28f98) with a first event code (0x09e28fa0) of at least 6 that is neither 0x12 nor 0x13; then requires ai_handler_counter_harmful_link(ctx, link) and the target-exception check on the link's resolve kind (as in the 0x1d8f handler). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1b5f: when the response-mode test accepts the link and it has targets, takes the first target; if it is a face-up Six Samurai (by visible name) and ai_is_valid_target(link, side, slot), it sets 0x09e28f8c = 1 around duel_effects_call_handler_08(link, side, slot) and accepts when that returns 0. Returns 1 or 0. Side effects: 0x09e28f8c set and cleared. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x192a and 0x1c88: when the response-mode test accepts the link (an opposing link per mode 0x09e0307c) and one of the link's targets is a valid target for ctx (ai_is_valid_target), returns ai_cond_has_target(ctx, link) evaluated with ctx +3 bit 7 set (cleared afterwards). Side effects: clears ctx +3 bit 7. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1e58 (table T3 entry): when the response-mode test accepts the link and one of its targets is valid for ctx, evaluates ai_cond_has_target(ctx, link) with ctx +3 bit 7 set, and then requires ai_handler_draw_if_safe(ctx, link). Side effects: clears ctx +3 bit 7. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1d2d: requires ai_handler_draw_if_safe (called with the incoming ctx and link registers; Ghidra shows no arguments, confidence medium), then accepts when the response-mode test accepts the link and one of its targets is a valid target for ctx (ai_is_valid_target). Returns 1 or 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1d82: requires ai_cond_has_cost(ctx); accepts when the response-mode test accepts the link and one of its targets is valid for ctx, otherwise returns ai_is_card_threatened_by_chain(ctx, link). Candidate score callback: when it is the view side's turn or the End Phase (phase 5), 0x1cee scores 500 per face-up attribute-2 monster plus Graveyard attribute-2 name, and 0x1c03 scores 1,000 per face-up Crystal Beast; at other times they score 2 and 1; other cards 0. No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ai_choose_rescue_cat_candidates(int side, int count, int unused, void *record)
column3: Two-pick chooser for card 0x1876: when the dialog answer 0x09e2d248 is 0 (first pick) it clears the scratch word 0x09e03068 and, if side has Extra Deck cards of frame 10, temporarily removes 0x1876 from its zone, then for every pair i < j of unselected, unvetoed candidates simulates summoning both (ai_sim_summon_card_to_field, pick order marked with duel_core_set_candidate_pick_order) and scores the best Extra Deck plan with ai_score_plan_improvement(working, saved, 0, -ATK of j); the best pair is stored as 0x09e03068 = i | j << 8 and its record copied to record (0x34 bytes); the zone is restored and i returned. On the second pick it returns j from 0x09e03068. Returns -1 when nothing fits. Side effects: writes 0x09e03068 and record, snapshots pushed/popped, plan globals overwritten by the searches. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

Clears the current link's (0x09e28e44) scratch words +0x10/+0x12; for link card 0x1dda with targets (link +7 bits 1-7) stores at +0x10 the visible card id of target 0 (duel_effects_get_link_target) and at +0x12 the low half of that slot's word +0x0c. Side effects: writes link +0x10/+0x12. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

column2: int ai_score_candidate_by_level_and_stats(int index, uint mode, int *stats)
column3: Candidate score callback: 600,000 when the candidate's level equals the non-zero level stored at the current link +0x12 (0x09e28e44), plus ai_score_candidate_vs_board_stats(index, mode, stats, estimated ATK, estimated DEF) (mode doubles as the skip-safety flag); card 0x1e15 loses 100,000 when above that; the total goes through ai_score_candidate_by_location (Ghidra types the function void; tail value, hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ai_score_candidate_by_stats_vs_board(int index, uint mode, int *stats)
column3: Candidate score callback: ai_score_candidate_by_location(index, ai_score_candidate_vs_board_stats(index, mode, stats, ATK, DEF)) with the estimated stats, except that card 0x1e12 is assumed to have ATK = the opponent's highest DEF + 1 (when that exceeds its highest ATK) or DEF = the opponent's highest ATK + 1 (Ghidra types it void; tail value, hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ai_score_fusion_by_hand_materials(int index, int unused, void *ctx)
column3: Candidate score callback for a Fusion Monster: the highest off-field ATK (at least ctx +0x0c) among the view side's hand monsters that are summonable (summon-set mask bit 0x10 clear), not worth keeping (ai_is_card_worth_keeping), allowed by ai_allows_summon_mode_04 with the current link's card, not refused by ai_check_card_condition, can be special summoned face-up from the hand and match one of the fusion's material codes >= 3,000 (duel_effects_card_matches_material_code). Returns 0 when none. No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ai_score_candidate_vs_board_krebons(int index, uint mode, int *stats)
column3: Candidate score callback: like ai_score_candidate_by_stats_vs_board, but card 0x1e24 counts its DEF as the opponent's highest ATK (stats +0x0c) when the view side's LP exceed ai_get_card_lp_amount(view side, 0x1e24, 0) and its DEF is not above that ATK; the result of ai_score_candidate_vs_board_stats(index, mode, stats, ATK, DEF) goes through ai_score_candidate_by_location (Ghidra types the function void; tail value, hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

Candidate score callback: ai_score_candidate_by_location(index, 100,000 - estimated ATK), or 200,000 - ATK for a Normal Monster (card_db_is_normal_monster) (Ghidra types it void; tail value, hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

Candidate score callback for Dragon-type (race 1) cards: level <= 3 scores the location-weighted ATK estimate (mode 2); level 4 scores 0; level >= 5 scores ATK (mode 1) + 100,000 when it can be special summoned, is not already in the view side's Graveyard and no earlier candidate index holds the same card, else 0; non-Dragons 0. No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ai_score_big_dragon_candidate_safe(int index, uint mode, int *stats)
column3: Candidate score callback: only Dragon-type (race 1) cards of level >= 5 that can be special summoned score; with mode 0 and an attacking opponent (stats +0x14 > 0) it returns 0 when Attack Position would be lethal (ai_filter_positions_by_lethal_attack), else ai_score_candidate_by_location(index, estimated ATK). Others 0. No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ai_score_red_eyes_dragon_candidate(int index, uint mode, int *stats)
column3: Candidate score callback: card 0x1d85 scores 200,000 (location-weighted) when not in the view side's Graveyard and not offered at an earlier index, else 0; card 0x1f2e at location 0x0d scores 100,000; other cards are scored like ai_score_big_dragon_candidate_safe (Dragon, level >= 5, special-summonable, safe Attack Position, ATK). No side effects. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

Returns -1 when the effect value 0x169c is already on side's player slot (0x0b); otherwise the first unselected, unvetoed candidate of card 0x169c owned by side (entry bit 14) that side does not hold in hand or set, skipping it while a type-1 0x1811 list effect (when duel_core_slot_has_effect(side, 0x0b, 0x1811)) points at a 0x169c copy at location 0x0f (same walk as ai_find_candidate_skipping_gold_sarcophagus); -1 when none. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

Returns the first unselected, unvetoed candidate of card 0x17af owned by side, but only when side still has each of 0x1788, 0x17ae and 0x17ad in deck or hand (duel_core_count_deck_cards_named + duel_core_count_hand_cards_named); -1 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

column2: int ai_find_candidate_from_ai_table(int side, uint exclude_card, void *table, int no_eval)
column3: Walks an AI priority table (ai_table_length/ai_table_entry) in order and, for each entry whose card is not exclude_card and is offered as an unselected, unvetoed candidate, builds a test link from a copy of the current link (0x09e28e44) with the slot field set to 0x0b (hand) and that card, temporarily appends the opponent's last Graveyard copy of the card to side's hand list (player block +0x124, count +0x0c), and checks duel_effects_can_activate_card(link, NULL); if activatable it returns the candidate index at once when no_eval is set, otherwise when ai_evaluate_activation(entry, link, 0, 1) accepts. The timing-event queue head 0x09e28f98 is zeroed during the search and restored. Returns -1 when no entry fits. Side effects: temporary hand-count change (restored); those of the handlers called by ai_evaluate_activation. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

column2: int ai_choose_monster_candidate_with_score_fn(int side, uint card, int unused, int count, uint mode, int *stats, void *score_fn, int fallback)
column3: Generic monster-candidate chooser over candidates 0..count-1 (unselected and not vetoed by ai_reject_candidate). When a monster is offered: with mode 0 and a special-summoning effect for card (ai_is_special_summon_effect on a zeroed link) it takes a Graveyard candidate 0x1bb7 first; without score_fn it scores each candidate with ai_score_candidate_by_location(ai_score_candidate_vs_board_stats(...)) (0 when Attack Position is lethal) and, failing that, falls back to score_fn = ai_score_candidate_by_safe_atk; the best positive score wins; otherwise, if fallback, a random unselected candidate (duel_core_random). With no monster offered: best positive score_fn result, then (with fallback or no score_fn) the first candidate side does not hold that is valuable (ai_is_valuable_card_id) or limited below 3, else a random unvetoed one. Returns the index or -1. Side effects: advances the RNG on the random paths; those of score_fn. Callers: 3 (ai_score_prisma_candidate_by_followup, ai_choose_candidate_by_card, ai_choose_name_copy_candidate).

Returns the first unselected, unvetoed candidate whose card is ai_is_valuable_card_id(card, 0) or is limited below 3 copies (deck_get_current_card_limit < 3); -1 when none. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

Among unselected, unvetoed candidates returns the one with the highest 2 * deck_get_current_card_limit(card) + (1 when not ai_is_valuable_card_id), i.e. the least restricted, least valuable card; -1 when none. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

Takes the chain link before the current one (ai_get_previous_chain_link(0x09e28e44)) and, for each of its targets (count byte +6 bits 1-7) that is not on side and lies in a Graveyard (location 0x0e), scans the candidates from the last to the first for an unselected, unvetoed one whose instance reference equals the target's (duel_effects_get_link_target_ref); returns that index, or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).
Returns the first unselected, unvetoed candidate not owned by side (entry bit 14) whose card is ai_is_graveyard_benefit_card; -1 when none. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

Counts the view side's cards that the AI tables would now activate, restricted to masks prepared in the current link (0x09e28e44) by ai_choose_name_copy_candidate: hand cards whose bit is set in link +0x08..+0x0f (up to 60) and accepted by ai_evaluate_card_all_tables on a hand link (ai_build_chain_context location 0x0b); Extra Deck entries in the mask link +0x10 (up to 15, after duel_effects_build_candidate_list(side, 0xfffe, 0x0c)) accepted by ai_eval_extra_deck_summon(side, i, 0, 0); monster zones 0-4 in link +0x12 except the slot held in 0x09e0306c. The candidate-list globals are saved and restored. Returns the count. Side effects: none lasting (candidate list restored); those of the evaluators. The caller passes a card argument that the code does not read. Callers: 2 (ai_score_candidate_stored_in_slot, ai_score_prisma_name_candidate).

Candidate score: attaches a kind-2 effect 0x1d43 holding the candidate's card to the slot packed in 0x09e0306c (side | slot << 8), counts ai_count_activatable_table_cards, detaches it, and scores count * 100,000, plus ai_rate_card_interest_in_graveyard(view side, card, -1) when the current link's card is 0x1d43. Returns the score (0 count when the attach fails). Side effects: temporary effect attachment (removed). Callers: 1 (ai_score_prisma_candidate_by_followup).

column2: int ai_score_prisma_candidate_by_followup(int index, uint mode, int *stats)
column3: Candidate score callback: saves the candidate list, rebuilds it for the follow-up choice (duel_effects_build_candidate_list(link side, link card, candidate card) from the current link 0x09e28e44), picks with ai_choose_monster_candidate_with_score_fn(link side, link card, 0, count from link +6 bits 1-7, mode, stats, ai_score_prisma_name_candidate, link +7 bit 0) and returns ai_score_prisma_name_candidate of the pick (0 when none); restores the candidate list. Side effects: candidate list rebuilt then restored; RNG on random fallbacks. No direct caller (candidate score callback reached through a function pointer).

column2: int ai_choose_name_copy_candidate(int side, uint card, int arg, int count, uint mode, int *stats, int fallback)
column3: Chooser for name-copying effects (cards 0x1dc2, 0x1d43, 0x0ea9): stores in 0x09e0306c the slot that will carry the copied name (0x1dc2: target 0 of the current link; 0x1d43: the link's own slot; 0x0ea9: a monster zone from ai_choose_monster_zone_for_card where 0x0ea9 is placed face-up in Attack Position by simulation with slot flag bit 0x0c), saves the link's scratch +0x08..+0x13 and fills it with masks of cards not activatable now (hand cards when ai_is_hand_over_limit_or_no_1387, Extra Deck cards summoned without Polymerization not flagged in 0x09e03088, monster zones 0-4). Unless fallback, an all-empty mask returns -1. Otherwise ai_choose_monster_candidate_with_score_fn with ai_score_prisma_candidate_by_followup (0x1d43 with arg 0, count and fallback stored in link +6/+7), ai_score_candidate_stored_in_slot (0x0ea9) or ai_score_prisma_name_candidate. Afterwards restores the link scratch, re-records the 0x1dc2 target (duel_effects_record_link_slot) or removes the simulated 0x0ea9, and restores 0x09e0306c and the candidate list. Returns the index or -1. Side effects: temporary simulation and link edits (restored); RNG. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

For card 0x1bef returns the first unselected, unvetoed candidate of 0x1645; for cards 0x1342/0x1315 the first such candidate of 0x0fbb, then 0x0fb7, 0x0fb8, 0x0fb9, 0x0fba in that order; -1 otherwise or when none is offered. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_exodia_piece_candidate).

Exodia-piece chooser: clears rule flag 0x200 of 0x09e03070; -1 unless side owns 0x0fbb (ai_owns_card); with 0x1645 owned it defers to ai_choose_exodia_necross_candidate. It builds bit masks (bit = card - 0x0fb7) of the five pieces 0x0fb7-0x0fbb in hand, Graveyard (player block +0x55c, count +0x14) and deck (+0x304, count +0x10). Cards 0x1342/0x1315 take side's 0x0fd6, then 0x11e4, else ai_pick_random_candidate_except_card(0x0fbb); the search cards 0x1e4a, 0x1ddc, 0x1dd4, 0x1d5f, 0x1d2f, 0x1366, 0x12ea, 0x137d, 0x133b take side's 0x0fd6 or 0x11e4 only; 0x132f takes 0x0fb7..0x0fba in order or a random non-0x0fbb card. Graveyard recoveries pick the highest pieces from the Graveyard mask (0x0eb7 up to 4, 0x1359 3 and 0x17f1 2 of 0x0fb7-0x0fba, 0x1d1d/0x1796/0x1845 one) and deck searches (0x1811, 0x11e4, 0x0fd6) one deck piece; 0x1845 proceeds only when the hand would hold all five (counting a 0x1359 follow-up with enough Graveyard monsters). When the hand would be complete it sets 0x09e03070 bit 0x200; it returns the first unselected, unvetoed candidate of the chosen pieces, or -1. Side effects: writes 0x09e03070 bit 0x200; RNG on the random path. Callers: 1 (ai_choose_candidate_by_card).

column2: int ai_choose_candidate_by_card(int side, uint card_id, int param, int mandatory)
column3: Picks one entry of the current candidate list (duel_core_get_candidate_count, list 0x09e29928) for side's effect of card_id and returns its index, -1 for no choice, or 0 when the AI-table path finds bit 1 of scratch word 0x09e03068 set. Returns -1 for an empty list and, when mandatory is 0, when every candidate is already selected (duel_core_get_candidate_selection > 0) or vetoed by ai_reject_candidate(top card of the AI candidate stack 0x09e03004, index). Then fills a 40-byte stat-extremes record (ai_collect_board_stat_extremes) and lets ai_choose_exodia_piece_candidate win. The rest is an if/else compare chain on card_id (about 235 distinct ids) whose cases have four shapes: (1) priority lists of named cards searched with ai_find_candidate_index_by_card / ai_find_candidate_by_card_and_side, often gated by what side holds (0x1b1d tries own 0x18c5, 0x1dbb, 0xfbe, then the opponent's 0x16be, 0x18bc; 0x1d89/0x1d3e/0x1cff/0x1474 try the pieces 0xfb7-0xfbb or 0x16f9, then 0x1dac, 0x19cb, ... and finally ai_score_candidate_by_interest); (2) a score callback and a mode word (0, 1 or 2; meaning open) for the generic picker (0x1e12 ai_score_candidate_by_stats_vs_board, 0x1dd6 ai_score_rainbow_dragon_candidate, 0xea8 extra-deck fusion score when param is 0 else low ATK preferring the Graveyard, 0x1ef3/0x1e4a/0x1e43 ai_score_candidate_by_plan_gain during side's own Main Phase); (3) full delegation (0x1dc2/0x1d43/0xea9 ai_choose_name_copy_candidate, 0x1876 ai_choose_rescue_cat_candidates, 0x1935 ai_find_candidate_for_attack_handler for link event codes 0x12/0x13); (4) small rules (0x1ce0 prefers pieces 0xfb7-0xfbb not yet marked with instance marker 0x1ce0; 0x1e78 refuses when the link card's DEF + 500 per selected candidate cannot stop the opposing attackers; 0x13ed/0x132f pick a random unselected candidate). A group of about 60 ids (0x1ef8, 0x1e7e, 0x16c5, 0x1482, ...) uses ai_score_candidate_for_graveyard_pick with mode 2, and an inner default, for cards whose link is the current link 0x09e28e44, searches tables D 0x09dffdc8, A 0x09dfe500 and B 0x09dfe848 with ai_find_candidate_from_ai_table. Cards matching no case go to ai_classify_gladiator_beast_for_battle (score ai_score_gladiator_beast_candidate) and every non-returning case ends in ai_choose_monster_candidate_with_score_fn(side, card_id, param, count, mode, extremes, score_fn, mandatory), whose result is returned. Side effects: 0x1e07 and 0x1b50 write words +0x12 and +0x08 of the current link 0x09e28e44 (Level difference to 0x1e10; ATK of the link's monster); 0x1c9b/0x1be9 give own copies pick order 10 (duel_core_set_candidate_pick_order); 0x17be/0x1712 write 0x09e03068 (0 or 1); 0x1900 saves the candidate list (0x800 bytes), its states 0x09e2a128 (0x400 bytes) and header words 0x09e29914-0x09e29924 and restores them around ai_count_acceptable_candidates(side, 0x1876, 0); the ai_note_* helpers of some cases write AI scratch state and 0x13ed/0x132f advance the RNG (duel_core_random). Callers: 3 (ai_choose_candidates_up_to, ai_simulate_candidate_choice, ai_choose_candidates_capped).

column2: int ai_choose_candidates_up_to(int side, uint card, int param, int max_picks, int flag)
column3: Rebuilds the board view (ai_analyze_board, side passed through a0) and the candidate list (duel_effects_build_candidate_list(side, card, param)), then picks up to min(count, max_picks) candidates one by one with ai_choose_candidate_by_card(side, card, param, flag), rebuilding the view after the first pick, marking each with duel_core_set_selected_candidate_index and duel_core_set_candidate_pick_order and counting in the dialog answer word 0x09e2d248. Stops at the first failed pick. Returns the number picked. Side effects: candidate list and selections, 0x09e2d248, board view. Callers: 1 (ai_simulate_candidate_choice).

column2: int ai_choose_candidates_capped(int side, uint card, int param, int max_picks, int flag)
column3: Same loop as ai_choose_candidates_up_to with the cap min(count, max_picks), further limited for card 0x18e0 to the opponent's spell/trap count (duel_core_count_spell_traps), and at least 1. Picks with ai_choose_candidate_by_card, recording selection, pick order and the count in 0x09e2d248. Returns the number picked. Side effects: candidate list and selections, 0x09e2d248, board view. Callers: 1 (ai_simulate_candidate_choice).

column2: uint ai_choose_declared_card_name(int side, int kind, uint card, int fallback)
column3: Chooses a card id to declare for card's effect and stores it in 0x09e2d248: 0x1803 names the card of instance link +0x14 (instance table 0x09e2bbcc, 6 bytes each) when the current link's event code is 0x1b and link +0x15 bit 1 is the other side; 0x1576 one of the first two monsters in the opponent's Graveyard (random), else 0x1576; 0x1568 a random main-deck monster from the instance table (random(0x200), up to 50 tries, not Token/Fusion/Synchro), else 0x0fa7; 0x1b67 a card from the previous chain link if it special summons (the Ritual Monster of a Ritual Spell, a fixed id for several summoning cards, or a target's card), falling back to the 0x1568 random path when fallback is set; 0x169d a random card of side's deck. Otherwise it reads the opponent: a random hand card (kind < 0x4d) or hand monster when its hand is revealed (duel_core_is_hand_revealed), else a random Graveyard card that is not an Extra Deck monster (or Graveyard monster for kind >= 0x4d), else a random card or monster of its registered deck list (0x09e02990 + side * 0xc0, count +0x1c, u16 ids at +0x28); 0x0fa7 if all fail. Returns the declared id (or -1 for 0x1b67 without fallback). Side effects: writes 0x09e2d248, rebuilds the board view, advances the RNG. Callers: 1 (ai_simulate_candidate_choice).

column2: bool ai_simulate_candidate_choice(int side, int kind, uint card, int param, int flag)
column3: Runs the AI's answer to a candidate selection of the given kind: sets the candidate header (0x09e29914 = side, 0x09e29918 = kind, 0x09e2991c = 0), clears the list arrays (0x800 bytes at 0x09e29928, 0x400 at 0x09e2a128), builds the list and reads the pick limit. Kinds 6 and 0x4a make one pick with ai_choose_candidate_by_card (true when found; 0x09e2d248 = 1); kinds 7-0x26 need kind - 6 picks (capped by the limit when flag) through ai_choose_candidates_up_to and succeed when all were made; kinds 0x28-0x47 use ai_choose_candidates_capped and succeed with at least one pick, kind 0x48 always; kinds above 0x4a declare a card name with ai_choose_declared_card_name (true when > 0). Other kinds return false. Side effects: rebuilds the candidate list and selections, 0x09e2d248, board view. Callers: 2 (ai_choose_candidate_index, ai_try_choose_candidates).

Per-card AI veto: true when the effect of card (normally the top of the AI candidate stack) should not take candidate index (its card c, owner bit 14, view side 0x09e02ffa). Generic: 0x1d83 refuses ATK >= 1,500 while 0x134a is active; 0x1dc2, 0x1d43, 0x1876, 0x1638, 0x0ea9 refuse a card already offered unselected at a lower index. For effects that do not special summon (candidate-stack class 0): per-card rules such as 0x1dda (link target and fixed coin call), 0x1dc4 (the own field-zone card), 0x1638 (ai_get_spell_search_priority must be the best), name copiers (the name already in slot 0x09e0306c), a list of about 30 searchers refusing special-summon condition classes 3-5 and 0x1dac, 0x1b22/0x1b62/0x1b1d/0x1d44 Graveyard rules (duel_core_call_graveyard_card_may_leave, previous link targets), senders to the Graveyard refusing Extra Deck monsters and ai_is_graveyard_benefit_card cards, and 0x1d89/0x1d3e/0x1cff/0x1474 summon rules (0x1cb7, 0x1ce0, special-summon-only, tribute-summon effects). For special-summoning effects: 0x1e12 versus the opponent's strongest Attack Position monster, 0x1ca0 valuable cards, 0x1c31, 0x17be/0x1712 duplicates and active copies, 0x1dd4/0x1d2f/0x137d (own Standby Phase: only five cards, each needing an acceptable candidate of its own, checked recursively with ai_push_candidate_card/ai_pop_candidate_card), 0x1c37/0x1af9/0x12ea (board flag 0x10, ai_get_card_rank > 1), duplicates of 0x1cf1-0x1cf3, and with board flag 0x20 a location-0x0d candidate when LP < 501 and card has genre 5. Returns false (accept) otherwise. Side effects: none lasting (the recursive check pushes and pops the candidate stack). Callers: 28 (ai_find_candidate_by_card_and_side, ai_count_acceptable_candidates, ai_pick_random_candidate_except_card, ai_count_acceptable_hand_candidates, ...); exported (2 import stubs without callers).

True when side's slot flags (+0x10, 0x09e2a56c) have bit 1 or bit 3 set (disabled) and the visible card's icon is 2, 3 or 4 (spell icons of cards that stay on the field). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_pick_spell_trap_slot_by_state).

column2: int ai_rate_slot_threat_with_links(int side, int slot, int arg_a, int arg_b)
column3: Returns 0 unless side's slot flags (+0x10) bit 10 is set; then ai_rate_slot_threat(side, slot, arg_a, arg_b), and for a monster adds 1 + the number of cards in either side's spell/trap zones 5-9 that are equipped to it (duel_core_is_equipped_by) and have a non-zero ai_rate_slot_threat(src, slot, 0, 0). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ai_call_rate_slot_threat_with_links, ai_call_rate_slot_threat_with_links_alt).

column2: int ai_call_rate_slot_threat_with_links(int side, int slot, int arg_a)
column3: Read from the disassembly (8-byte tail jump; the decompiler hides the delay-slot argument): j ai_rate_slot_threat_with_links with a3 = 0, i.e. returns ai_rate_slot_threat_with_links(side, slot, arg_a, 0). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_pick_slot_by_threat).

column2: int ai_call_rate_slot_threat_with_links_alt(int side, int slot, int arg_a)
