Returns 1 on the first ritual monster with a selectable Tribute, else 0. Side effects: writes ctx +8; the simulated slot edits set the dominance-stale flag. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1407: true when the controller's battle dominance is >= 1. Otherwise true only when the opponent's player slot (0x0b) has marker 0x1a9d with the ctx card as value (duel_core_has_marker_value), the controller holds no hand card of race 0x17 (not counting the ctx card itself when it is in the hand, slot 0x0b) and none of race 0x18, and has no face-down spell/trap (duel_core_count_spell_traps_ex(side, 0, 1, 1) == 0). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x15e7: accepts (1) when ai_rate_lp_gain(controller, card) is non-zero, except that a response (arg != 0) of a card with no handler-table selector and icon 4 skips that test. Otherwise it evaluates the damage with ctx +0xc = 2: ai_eval_damage_effect(ctx, 0, NULL) >= 0 returns that value (1 lethal, 0 no damage); for "hold non-lethal burn" (< 0) it accepts when card 0x159b is active on the own side or no 0x159b is left in the hand or Deck. Restores ctx +0xc. Side effects: ctx +0xc modified and restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1ebd: only past the summon step (ai_is_past_summon_step); requires a non-zero ai_rate_lp_gain(controller, card) (for a response, arg != 0, a card without handler-table selector and with icon 4 fails this test), then a target: ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) >= 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Shared AI handler: true when duel_core_call_graveyard_card_may_leave(controller, own side) is non-zero (the Graveyard cards may be returned) and ai_handler_draw_if_safe(ctx) accepts. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1baf: returns 1 when the opponent would deck out drawing 2 (ai_would_deck_out(opponent, opponent, 2)); otherwise 1 when the own Deck (count player +0x10, list +0x304) holds a card of race 4 (card_db_get_race), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x132e (controller = ctx side xor +3 bit 6). Returns 1 when card 0x1366 is active on the controller's side, or duel_core_count_active_cards_value_at_least finds 0x1102 (>= 2), 0x1400, 0x1dd1 (>= 1); returns 2 for 0x1de2 (>= 1). Otherwise: with 0x16f8 active, 0x1712 and 0x17a3 held (ai_has_card_in_hand_or_field) and 0x16da or 0x15fe active on the opponent's side, true when an own monster zone holds 0x1d00, 0x1627, 0x1565, 0x11a6 or 0xfff with slot flag bit 8 clear; an own active spell/trap (flag bit 2 clear) named 0x137d, 0x1dd4, 0x1ddc or 0x1e4a decides by its linked slot (duel_core_find_linked_slot: none -> true; a linked 0x11e4/0xfd6 -> true when its owner bit is the controller; otherwise true when the linked side is not the controller). Last test: the controller can enter battle, the opponent has spell/traps, fewer monsters and no valuable effect card in zones 0-4 (ai_is_valuable_effect_card), and the plan value is >= 3,000 or >= the opponent's LP. Else 0. No side effects (may re-plan through ai_get_plan_value). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Shared AI handler for mass spell/trap removal: with mask = duel_effects_get_target_filter_mask(ctx), counts the controller's and the opponent's cards in it (the controller's field zone counts when in the mask and its flag bit 8 is clear); 0 when the opponent has none or card 0x1a7e is active on the controller's side. Card 0x1d12 refuses while 0x1a77 is active and neither 0x1a77 nor 0x1d17 is in hand; card 0x14df needs a cost from ai_choose_cost_for_current_link over the filtered mask whose monster has no planned attack. Returns 1 when the opponent loses more (ai_count_threatening_slots_in_mask + ai_count_valuable_cards_in_mask), or when the opponent has >= 2 cards and more than the controller; otherwise 1 only when the controller can enter battle, its dominance is < 1 and ai_eval_dominance_change(side, mask, 1, NULL) >= 1. Else 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_sim_apply_summon_effect).

AI handler for cards 0x142c and 0x15fe: true when ai_is_card_count_below(ctx, 1, 0) and ai_rate_lp_gain(controller, card) is non-zero; for a response (arg != 0) by a card without handler-table selector and with icon 4 the rate counts as 0 (refuse). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x16ce: returns 1 when one of the owner's monsters 0-4 has a planned attack dealing damage in the owner's saved battle plan (attack entry +2 and +0x18 non-zero), has non-zero DEF and is a valid target (ai_is_valid_target(ctx, owner, slot)); else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x15f2 and 0x12bf: 0x12bf refuses when the opponent's player slot (0x0b) has effect 0x12bf. Requires opposing Defense Position monsters (duel_core_count_monsters_in_position(opponent, 1)) and that the controller can enter battle; returns 1 when an own monster in zones 0-4 can attack now and has no piercing (duel_core_has_piercing), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x0ec6: only when the opponent has at most 1,000 LP and the controller's dominance is negative; the target mask must hold exactly one opposing card and the opponent's damage must not be turned into LP gain (duel_core_is_damage_converted_to_gain). If the controller has any monster in zones 0-4 (non-zero duel_core_get_attribute_mask), stores the opponent side in 0x09e03068 and returns ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, mask, 1) >= 0; else false. Side effects: writes 0x09e03068. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1e3d: only with negative dominance, exactly one opposing card in the target mask and no damage-to-gain conversion for the opponent; when an own monster's original ATK / 2 is at least the opponent's LP, stores the opponent side in 0x09e03068 and returns ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, mask, 1) >= 0; else false. Side effects: writes 0x09e03068. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1e6b: requires the owner's saved plan to leave no opposing monster (plan +0x06 == 0) and ai_is_card_count_below(ctx, 1, 1); then returns 1 when one of the plan's attack-order records (plan +0x144, 16 bytes each, scanned while record +2 is non-zero) has +4 == 5 (a direct attack), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1ef0: picks a candidate with ai_simulate_candidate_pick(ctx, controller) (0 when none), clears the summon-choice word 0x09e03088, finds the selected candidate's instance in the controller's Extra Deck (duel_core_find_extra_deck_card_by_instance) and returns ai_eval_extra_deck_summon(side, that index, 0, 52-byte scratch); restores 0x09e03088. Side effects: candidate list rebuilt; 0x09e03088 restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1927: picks a cost with ai_choose_cost_as_side(ctx, owner, card, target mask, 1) and a candidate (ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6)); then temporarily replaces the cost monster by the selected candidate (ai_sim_set_slot_card) with slot flag bits 22-23 cleared and simulates its attack (ai_simulate_attack(side, slot, 0, 1, 0)); returns 1 when that succeeds and either word 0x09e27828 (working plan +0x144) is 5 or the new visible ATK is >= the cost's, else 0. Afterwards it sets flag bit 23 (if bit 22 is now set) or bit 22, which does not restore the original bits (confidence medium), and puts the cost card back. Side effects: slot flag word of the cost slot; dominance-stale flag. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x0ece (a burn by sent monsters, hypothesis medium): false when the controller holds more than 2 hand cards or cannot damage the opponent (ai_can_damage_opponent); picks a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller) and estimates the LP change with the opponent's entry preset to -(the target's visible ATK). With per-use damage d, n = ceil(opponent LP / d) uses are needed; refuses when the controller's own loss x n would reach its LP or n exceeds its Deck monsters (duel_core_count_deck_monsters); otherwise returns true when 1000 x the product over n draws of (monsters left / Deck size left) is >= 300 (at least a 30 % chance of drawing monsters each time). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x12f9: when committed (ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard) true if the opponent's Graveyard (count player +0x14) is non-empty. Otherwise true when the opponent has >= 5 Graveyard cards; else only when the owner has a ready set 0x14f0 (ai_has_set_spell_trap_card(owner, 0x14f0, 1)), more than 14 Graveyard cards, and either ai_is_not_spell_blocked_by_17a3(owner, 0x14f0) is 0 or the owner has more than 1,000 LP. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1389: with a = the owner's best face-up monster ATK (ai_get_best_monster_stats(owner, &a, &d, 1)), returns 1 when an opposing face-up monster's battle stat (ATK in Attack Position, DEF in Defense Position) exceeds a while its other stat is below a (a position change would expose it), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x0ecd and 0x12be: returns 1 when the controller has no face-up 0x12be (duel_core_has_face_up_spell_trap_12be == 0) and holds a Toon monster in hand (card_db_is_toon), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1b50: true when the controller can enter battle, the ctx monster can attack now (ai_can_attack_now), the owner's plain battle dominance is negative and ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6) succeeds. Side effects: the candidate list is rebuilt. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1d83: needs a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, target mask, 1) >= 0) and a candidate (ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6)); true when the selected candidate's printed ATK exceeds the opponent's best attacker ATK. Side effects: the candidate list is rebuilt. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1cee: when the owner's plan value is below the opponent's LP and the ctx monster's ATK a does not beat the opponent's best visible battle stat t, it counts n = cards in the target mask + Attribute-2 monsters in the owner's Graveyard; returns 1 when a + 500 x n >= t and no own monster in the target mask (zones 0-4) already has ATK >= that boosted value, else 0. No side effects (may re-plan). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Tests side's hand for a monster worth handing over (control-giving effects such as card 0x142a). Requires a Normal Summon and a free monster zone. Per hand card: 0x1d9d -> 1 when the summon slack (0x09e2800c + side * 0x30c) is non-zero, card is 0x142a, 0x175e is not active and neither 0x17fe nor 0x1102 is active on side; 0x1bed and 0x118a -> 1 with slack; 0x1eaf -> 1 with slack when no face-up race-2 monster exists on either side; 0x11f5 -> the opponent's hand count; 0x1e2d -> the opponent's hand count when slack; any other card -> 1 when ai_is_ranked_card_with_low_atk(side) (arguments as decompiled). Returns 0 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ai_handler_check_cost_1925, ai_handler_check_targets_by_dominance_142a).

AI handler for card 0x142a (control swap): false while rule flag 0x09e03070 & 0x80 is set or ai_has_hand_monster_to_give_away(owner, card) succeeds; the target mask must hold cards of both sides. After ai_get_plan_value_with_give_away_card(owner), true when an own target scores > 5 with ai_rate_any_monster_to_give_away, or scores > 0 and every opposing target has higher visible ATK; otherwise true only when the opponent has exactly one monster, the plain dominance is negative and ai_count_valuable_effect_targets(ctx, owner) is 0. Side effects: re-plans. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1c35 (control swap): false while rule flag 0x09e03070 & 0x80 is set; with the target mask, true when the owner's weakest target (ai_pick_monster_by_stats(owner, mask, -1, 0)) has lower ATK than the opponent's weakest target; otherwise true only when the opponent has exactly one monster, the plain dominance is negative and ai_count_valuable_effect_targets(ctx, owner) is 0; false when either side has no target. Side effects: the picker advances the RNG. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1599. With a handler-table selector (ctx +3 bits 4-5): returns 1 when the owner has >= 2 Deck cards and its player slot (0x0b) carries marker 0x18db or 0x12a1 whose value is the instance of its Deck entry 0 (duel_core_has_marker_value), or when the opponent has >= 2 Deck cards and marker 0x1549 for its Deck entry 0; else 0. Without selector: requires ai_is_card_count_below(ctx, 1, 0) and returns 1 when the opponent's player slot has effect 0x1549 or the owner's has 0x18db or 0x12a1, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x0ebc: requires that the controller can damage the opponent and has race-4 cards in its Deck (duel_core_get_off_field_race). Without a handler-table selector it returns ai_is_card_count_below(ctx, 1, 0). With one it requires no planned attacker in the controller's saved plan (plan +0x146 == 0), no deck-out after 3 draws, a negative LP change for the opponent from ai_estimate_lp_change with that entry preset to -500, and a Deck no larger than 5 x the race-4 count. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x169e: returns 1 when the owner can Special Summon, has a free monster zone and holds a Dark Scorpion monster in hand (card_db_is_dark_scorpion), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1857: 0 while rule flag 0x09e03070 & 0x80 is set. For each opposing monster 0-4 in the target mask that has no links from cards 0x1322, 0x1466, 0x18bf, 0x18c0, 0x18c1, 0x18c2, 0x1a9c, 0x1df0, 0x1edf (duel_core_count_links_from): returns 1 when it has no link from 0x169a either, or when it is an Archfiend and the opponent has fewer than 2 face-up Archfiends. Else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x15e3: returns 1 when the owner holds 0x1ad6 in hand or on the field (ai_has_card_in_hand_or_field) and an opposing monster 0-4 in the target mask passes ai_is_level_4_or_5, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1c58: needs a candidate (ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6)). When the candidate is 0x1c22: true if the controller can Normal Summon now, ai_choose_candidate_for_card(side, 0x1c22, 0, 3) picks 0x1cf1 and 0x1cf1 has acceptable candidates. Otherwise true when the controller can enter battle and ai_plan_battle_with_summoned_monster(owner, controller, -1, candidate card, candidate instance, 0, 0, ctx card, 0, 0, 1, 0) is non-zero. Side effects: candidate list rebuilt; the plan simulation. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1b27: returns 1 when card 0x1bb7 is in the owner's Deck. Otherwise requires that the controller can enter battle and that ai_simulate_candidate_pick(ctx, owner) picks a candidate of Level > 5 for which ai_count_acceptable_candidates(owner, card, Level) is >= 0, returning 1; else 0. Side effects: candidate list rebuilt. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x12fa: returns 1 when a monster in the owner's hand gains from being sent to the Graveyard (ai_rate_send_to_graveyard_benefit(card, 0, 0) non-zero), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x0e88 and 0x1b5c. Without a handler-table selector (ctx +3 bits 4-5): when duel_core_is_field_spell(card) is 0 and the owner's field zone (slot 10) is empty or face-down (face-up word 0x09e2a62c + side * 0xb3c is 0), it temporarily sets the selector to 3 and returns duel_effects_call_handler_0c_b(ctx, arg); else false. With a selector: true, except card 0x149c, which needs at least one acceptable candidate (duel_effects_get_candidate_param). Side effects: ctx +3 modified and restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x0e8b: requires no handler-table selector, duel_core_is_field_spell(card) == 0 and an empty or face-down own field zone; then 0 when card 0xe8a is not active on the owner's side, 1 when it is not active on the opponent's side, else 1 only with battle dominance >= 1. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x150b: true only when the ctx card instance (u16 +4 >> 5, table 0x09e2bbcc) is 0x150b and either the owner's field zone shows the face-down stand-in 0x10f4 or, without a handler-table selector, that zone is empty or face-down. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x183f: true when the opponent controls spell/traps (duel_core_count_spell_traps), the ctx has no handler-table selector, duel_core_is_field_spell(card) is 0 and the owner's field zone is empty or face-down. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x0ec3: false when ai_choose_declared_attribute(controller, 0x171f, 1, 0xfe, 1) is >= 1 or the controller has a monster in zones 0-4 (positive duel_core_get_attribute_mask); otherwise true when there is no handler-table selector, duel_core_is_field_spell(card) is 0 and the owner's field zone is empty or face-down. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1eb1: ai_choose_declared_type(controller, 0xeb4, -1, 1) and ai_choose_declared_type(controller, 0x1357, -1, 1) must each be 0 or 2 (false otherwise); then true when there is no handler-table selector, duel_core_is_field_spell(card) is 0 and the owner's field zone is empty or face-down. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1eec: true when the ctx has no handler-table selector, the owner's field zone is empty or face-down, the owner has a face-up monster of race 0x12 and the opponent has none. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x0eb7: returns 1 when the ctx has a handler-table selector. Otherwise requires an empty or face-down own field zone, at least 2 acceptable candidates (ai_count_acceptable_candidates(controller, card, 0)) and all five of the controller's monster zones usable (duel_core_is_zone_usable_lenient), returning 1; else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x161c: requires a committed activation or a discard (ai_choose_discard(owner, ctx card instance, 1) >= 0); then builds the mask of races of all face-up monsters on both sides (bit = duel_core_get_race) and returns ai_choose_declared_type(owner, card, that mask, 1) != 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x14cb: needs a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, target mask, 1)). Outside Main Phase 2 (phase 0x09e2d1e8 != 4) it refuses when the ctx monster has a planned attack in the owner's saved plan. An own-side target accepts; an opposing target accepts when its visible battle stat exceeds the owner's best attacker ATK, else when ai_rate_slot_threat(opponent, slot, card) is non-zero. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1d8a: the cost passes when the activation is committed, when the ctx event code is 0x24, when the ctx card instance is 0x1935 while the card is not, or when ai_choose_hand_card_as_side(owner, 2, duel_effects_select_filter_hand_candidate) finds a hand card. Then true only when removing the target mask plus the ctx card's own slot improves the owner's dominance (ai_eval_dominance_change(owner, mask, 1, NULL) > 0). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x15df: clears ctx +8, takes the target mask with filter duel_effects_target_filter_1494 and collects the Levels (1-6) of the opposing targets as a bit set L; 0 when empty. Returns 0 when an own target of Level < 7 passes the test (L & 1 << (L & 31)) == 0 (the code tests a bit of L indexed by L itself, apparently a slip for the monster's Level; keep it in a port), has ai_rate_slot_threat(owner, slot, card, 1) < 2 and loses dominance when removed (ai_eval_dominance_change < 0); else 1. Side effects: writes ctx +8. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1d84: true when committed. Otherwise needs a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, mask, 1)); v = the highest visible ATK among the owner's 0x18f6 monsters with a planned attack in its saved plan (-1 when none). A monster-zone target accepts when v <= its visible battle stat; any other target only when v < 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for cards 0x12f8 and 0x145e: 0x12f8 first needs a committed activation or a discard (ai_choose_discard(owner, ctx card instance, 1)). Then a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller): an own-side target accepts, an opposing one only while the owner's battle dominance is negative. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x14e0: with ctx +0xc = 2 it asks for a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller) and returns 1 when one exists. Otherwise, with ctx +0xc = 1, returns ai_eval_damage_effect(ctx, 0, NULL) (1 lethal, 0 none) or, for "hold non-lethal burn" (< 0), 1 when card 0x159b is active on the owner's side or no 0x159b is left in its hand and Deck. Restores ctx +0xc to 0. Side effects: ctx +0xc. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1dbf: for each controller monster zone holding the ctx card without effect 0xfb6 it picks a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller with a shrinking mask); for a face-up target it presets the opponent's LP entry to -(target visible ATK), estimates the LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0)) and applies it to both players' real LP words (clamped at 0), summing the damage; n counts the uses. With n = 0 returns 0. Restores both LP words, then returns 1 when the simulated opponent LP reached 0 or the controller's dominance is negative; otherwise compares with the controller's saved plan: 0 when n is below plan +0x02 (opponent monsters destroyed) or equal with less damage than the plan value (+0x08), else 1. Side effects: the LP words are modified and restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Shared AI handler: with ctx byte +3 bit 7 set it needs a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller; on failure it returns false and leaves bit 7 set); then clears the bit. True at once for event code 0x24 or a ctx card instance of 0x1935 while the card is not. Otherwise picks the cost (ai_choose_cost_for_current_link over the target mask): a cost of the other side accepts; an own cost accepts when the target is also own or not a monster (slot > 4) and removing both keeps the dominance (ai_eval_dominance_change >= 0), or else when the cost's visible battle stat is below the target's. No side effects beyond ctx +3. Callers: 1 (ai_handler_draw_if_safe_1e58).

AI handler for card 0x1970: needs a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller); an own-side target, a committed activation, or a controller that does not own card 0x1969 (ai_owns_card) returns 1; otherwise 1 only when a card in the controller's hand gains from being sent to the Graveyard (ai_rate_send_to_graveyard_benefit), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1bda: counts the targets on the opponent's side with ctx byte +3 bit 7 temporarily set (ai_count_targets_on_side); false when none. True when the controller has no free spell/trap zone; otherwise only with dominance < 1 and own targets that number at least 2, or at least 1 with dominance < -2. Side effects: ctx +3 modified and restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1430: only with the owner's dominance < 1. Picks a first target with ctx byte +6 bits 1-7 set to 1 and a second with them cleared (both must exist, ai_choose_target_as_controller). While rule flag 0x09e03070 & 0x80 is set, a first target owned by the ctx side (slot byte +1 bit 6) returns 1. AI handler for card 0x0eaa (300 damage per destroyed card, hypothesis medium): presets each side's LP entry to -300 x its cards in the target mask, estimates the LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0)) and returns 1 when the opponent's LP would reach 0 while the controller survives; when the controller survives but the opponent does not die it returns ai_eval_dominance_change(controller, mask, 1, NULL) (positive accepts); when the controller would die, 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x175b: true when the opponent has face-down spell/traps and the target mask is not empty. Otherwise it removes, for the simulation, the owner's monsters with the same name as card 0xfa7 (card_db_is_same_name) and the opponent's monsters in the target mask (ai_sim_clear_slot_card, ids saved), re-plans (ai_get_planned_attacker(owner, 0)) and wins when an attacker exists and the working plan value (0x09e276ec, plan +0x08) reaches the opponent's LP; after restoring the own monsters it also accepts when the dominance was < 1 before and is > 0 with the opposing targets still removed; then restores those. Side effects: temporary slot edits (restored; dominance-stale flag), re-plans. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x1475: needs a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller); returns 1 when some face-up monster of the opponent (zones 0-4) has DEF at most the target's ATK, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x17f6: needs a target (ai_choose_target_as_controller); then true when committed, when the opponent's LP is at most the printed ATK of card 0xff8, when the owner holds 0x1894 in hand, or when the opponent controls spell/traps; else false. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler for card 0x15bc: returns 1 when the owner still has a Normal Summon, its summon slack (0x09e2800c + side * 0x30c) is above 1, and it holds a monster in hand that is not Special-Summon-only and has Level > 4 (duel_core_get_level_by_ref); else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1600: true at once when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx); otherwise true when the own side (ctx +2 bit 0) holds 0x19a5 in hand and controls at least 2 face-up monsters of race 3, or when a Normal Summon is still available (duel_core_has_normal_summon), the board-view summon slack (0x09e2800c + side * 0x30c) is above 1 and the hand (player block list +0x124, count +0x0c) holds a monster that is not special-summon-only with level > 4 (duel_core_get_level_by_ref on the entry's instance number), and otherwise when ai_get_battle_dominance(own side) < 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1a0d: picks a target with ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1); refuses (0) when there is none or it is not on the opponent's side. With h = half the target's original ATK, returns 0 when h is below ai_get_plan_value(own side) (the planned battle damage), 1 when h reaches the opponent's LP (0x09e2a528 + opponent * 0xb3c), when h > 1000 or when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx), else 0. Side effects: those of the chooser (view side switched and restored) and of ai_get_plan_value (may re-plan). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1abb: true when ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) returns a target (side | slot << 8, either side) whose original ATK halved is at least the opponent's LP. Side effects: those of the chooser (view side switched and restored). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1af7: picks the own-side slot of the target mask with the best original ATK (ai_pick_slot_by_score(own side, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), duel_core_get_original_atk)) and returns 1 when half that original ATK is at least the opponent's LP, 0 otherwise or when no slot is found. Side effects: advances the duel RNG (the picker shuffles). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x143a: refuses while AI rule flag 0x09e03070 & 0x80 is set and before the summon steps are over (ai_is_past_summon_step); a non-monster card whose handler selector (ctx +3 bits 4-5) is not 0 is refused; for cards 0x1c38, 0x1309, 0x10e7, 0x10e0, 0x10df, 0x10d6 it also requires the turn counter 0x09e2d1e0 < u32 0x09e029ac + u32 0x09e02a6c (first words of the duelist-0 and duelist-1 deck structures; meaning of the sum unknown). Then true when ai_choose_slot_for_ctx(ctx, own side, -1, 0) >= 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x19bb: returns ai_eval_damage_effect(ctx, 0, &damage) when it is >= 0. For the "hold" result (< 0): 0 when damage < 1, 1 when damage reaches the opponent's LP; otherwise, when the controller (side ^ ctx +3 bit 6) can enter the Battle Phase, 0 if the ctx monster (location ctx +2 bits 1-5) has a planned attack in the own saved plan (ai_plan_get_attack_entry(0x09e279c8 + side * 0x2e4, slot) +2 != 0), and 1 if the opponent has a face-down spell/trap (duel_core_count_spell_traps_ex(opponent, 0, 1, 0) > 0) and the saved plan has an attacker (plan +0x146 != 0); 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1562: true when an own face-up card in slots 0-10 (ai_is_slot_face_up, ai_get_visible_card_id) is a card that gains spell counters (card_db_gains_spell_counter_on_spell); otherwise true when ai_count_acceptable_candidates(controller, card, duel_effects_get_candidate_param(ctx)) > 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1445: while the card instance (ctx +4 bits 5-13) carries fewer than 3 markers keyed by its own id (duel_core_count_instance_markers), true when ai_count_acceptable_candidates(controller, card, duel_effects_get_candidate_param(ctx)) > 0; with 3 or more, true only when the opponent has at least 2 monsters, the controller can enter the Battle Phase and ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) finds a target. Side effects: those of the chooser (view side switched and restored). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1ebc: true when the controller (side ^ ctx +3 bit 6) would not deck out after 4 draws (ai_would_deck_out(controller, controller, 4) false) and ai_count_acceptable_candidates(controller, card, duel_effects_get_candidate_param(ctx)) > 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1d89: true when the own side may send a monster to the Graveyard (duel_core_can_send_to_graveyard(side, 1)), ai_choose_hand_card_as_side(side, card, NULL) finds a hand card, and ai_count_acceptable_candidates(controller, card, duel_effects_get_candidate_param(ctx)) > 0. Side effects: those of the hand chooser (view side switched and restored). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1474, for the controller c: if c's deck holds exactly one 0x16f9, returns 1 only when 0x1403 is active on c's side and c has a face-up monster or a hand card of race 0x0b, 0x0c or 0x10; otherwise returns 1 when 0x1ce0 is active on c's side, 0 when 0x1ce0 is in the hand while c's Graveyard has monsters, 1 when it is in the hand and the Graveyard has none, and, when it is not in the hand, 1 only if c's deck has no 0x1ce0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1edd: needs ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx) or a discard (ai_choose_discard(own side, instance ctx +4 bits 5-13, 1) >= 0). Then simulates the effect: flips the position word (slot +0x06) of every monster of the controller's opponent in ai_get_target_mask(ctx), re-plans with ai_get_planned_attacker(controller, -1), flips them back, and returns true when ai_compare_plans(working plan 0x09e276e4, saved plan 0x09e279c8 + controller * 0x2e4) > 1 (any criterion bit 0x02-0x10). Side effects: re-plans (battle plan blocks); the slot positions are restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1638: the cost test passes when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx), when the ctx event code ((u16 ctx +2 & 0xfff) >> 6) is 0x24, when the instance record (0x09e2bbcc + instance * 6) holds 0x1935 while the ctx card is not 0x1935, or when ai_choose_hand_card_as_side(own side, 2, duel_effects_select_filter_hand_candidate) finds a hand card; then true when ai_count_acceptable_candidates(controller, card, duel_effects_get_candidate_param(ctx)) > 0. Side effects: those of the hand chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1845: 1 when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx). Otherwise picks a discard with ai_choose_discard(own side, instance, 1) (none: 0); returns 1 when the discard is not a Forbidden One piece (card_db_is_forbidden_one), the side owns 0xfbb but not 0x1645 (ai_owns_card), ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6) and AI rule flag 0x09e03070 & 0x200 is set; else 1 when the own Graveyard holds a monster of race 0x16, else 1 when 0x18f6 is in the Graveyard but not in the hand or on the field, else 1 when the hand has no monster; 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1893: false unless the controller can enter the Battle Phase and the opponent has a monster; then true when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx), otherwise when ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) returns a target whose current ATK (duel_core_get_atk) is at least 1000. Side effects: those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x18ca: sets u16 ctx +0x0a to 1 while it computes ai_get_target_mask(ctx); with an empty mask returns 0 (leaving +0x0a = 1). Otherwise clears +0x0a, discards the mask when it holds 2 or more own monster zones, and returns 1 when an own monster zone 0-4 not in the mask holds a card owned by the other side (slot id bit 14 != own side), with non-zero original ATK, that ai_is_valid_target(ctx, own side, slot) accepts; 0 otherwise. Side effects: writes u16 ctx +0x0a. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x16a0: returns 1 when an own monster zone 0-4 holds a card owned by the other side (slot id bit 14, byte +0x35 bit 6, differs from the own side ctx +2 bit 0) with non-zero original ATK that ai_is_valid_target(ctx, own side, slot) accepts, 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1515: returns 1 when the opponent's Graveyard (player block list +0x55c, count +0x14) holds one of 18 hard-coded card ids (0x1b2a, 0x1a8a, 0x1571, 0x1459, 0x1919, ..., 0x197f), 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1b44: returns 1 when ai_can_summon_dark_armed_dragon(own side, 1) and the own Graveyard holds exactly 2 monsters of attribute 2; otherwise 1 when the opponent's Graveyard holds one of the same 18 card ids as ai_handler_check_graveyard_1515 (0x1b2a, 0x1a8a, ..., 0x197f), 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Shared AI handler for Fusion-summon spells: 0 when the own saved plan (0x09e279c8 + side * 0x2e4) already wins the duel (+0x22), when the own side has 0x1a4e or 0x157e on the field (duel_core_count_side_slots_named), or when ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6) fails. Card 0x149c: with handler selector 0 (ctx +3 bits 4-5) only when it is not a field spell and the own field zone is empty or face-down (slot 10 face-up word 0x09e2a62c), then returns duel_effects_call_handler_0c_b(ctx, arg) with the selector temporarily set to 3; with another selector, ai_count_acceptable_candidates > 0. Card 0x18fe: duel_core_can_enter_battle_phase(controller). Other cards: 1. Side effects: ctx +3 selector bits changed and reset to 0 for 0x149c. Callers: none direct; AI priority table entry (see docs/formats/ai-tables.md), and ai_handler_fusion_summon_1d2a searches table B for it.

AI handler of card 0x1d2a: 0 when the own player slot 11 already has a marker keyed by the card (duel_core_slot_has_effect); otherwise attaches one (duel_core_attach_effect(side, 0x0b, 1, card, 0), a recursion guard), finds in table B (0x09dfe848) the first entry whose handler is ai_handler_fusion_summon and calls ai_try_table_entry_default(own side, entry) on it and the following entries until one succeeds (returns 1) or the entry of card 0x1d2a is reached (returns 0), then detaches the marker. Side effects: temporary marker on the player slot; a successful entry activates that card (commands issued by ai_try_table_entry). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

column2: bool ai_eval_tribute_cost_for_damage(void *ctx, uint mask, int *lp_change, int tributes, int check_attack)
column3: Tribute-cost check of the tribute-for-damage handlers (fifth argument in t0): false unless lp_change[opponent] < 0 and the own loss -lp_change[own] is below the own LP; with check_attack, false when the controller can enter battle and the ctx monster has a planned attack in the own saved plan. Then picks tributes one by one with ai_choose_slot_from_mask(own side, mask minus picked), stopping at an own monster that has a planned attack (when battle is possible); true when all tributes were picked and ai_eval_dominance_change(own side, picked mask, 1, NULL) >= 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_handler_tribute_for_damage).

Loop-burn combo check for controller c: needs a non-empty mask, lp_change[opponent] < 0, either no own loss or ceil(own LP / opponent damage) * own loss < own LP, card 0x17a3 active on c's side and 0x1712 in c's hand or on the field. Unless the opponent's LP gain is reversed (duel_core_is_lp_gain_reversed), returns 0 when (active copies of 0x16da + 0x15fe on the opponent's side) * 500 covers the damage. Returns 1 when the mask covers a monster zone (either side) holding 0x16f8 (raw and visible id) owned by c, else 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ai_handler_tribute_for_damage_combo, ai_handler_check_lp_0fff).

Shared AI handler for "tribute monsters to deal damage" cards: per-card constants (0x1aa0: count 1 and check_attack 1; 0x1d0b and 0x144b: 2 tributes per use; others 1 per use, count -1). Estimates the LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0)) and refuses unless out[opponent] < (1 - own side) (read literally; probably meant "< 0"); with an empty ai_get_target_mask returns 0; returns 1 when ai_eval_damage_per_tribute(ctx, mask, out, per_use, count), else ai_eval_tribute_cost_for_damage(ctx, mask, out, per_use, check_attack). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_handler_tribute_for_damage_1627); also an AI priority table entry (see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Second AI handler of card 0x1ec4: 0 when the ctx event argument (+0x14) is non-zero; otherwise returns ai_eval_damage_effect(ctx, 0, &damage) when that is >= 0; for the "hold" result, adds max(damage - 300, 0) to damage when the ctx slot has no 0x1ec4 marker (duel_core_slot_has_effect) and returns 1 when the damage is positive and at least the opponent's LP, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1627: with handler selector 0 (ctx +3 bits 4-5, spell/trap activation) returns ai_is_card_count_below(ctx, 1, 0) (no active copy), otherwise ai_handler_tribute_for_damage(ctx) (tail calls; Ghidra shows no return value, hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of cards 0x1855 and 0x0fff: for every slot 0-10 of both sides in ai_get_target_mask(ctx), sets the opponent's loss to half the current ATK (card 0xfff) or to the card_db ATK of the visible raw id (other card) and estimates the LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, rec, 1, 0)); for 0xfff it sums all targets whose own loss keeps the own LP above 0, for the other card it keeps the single largest. Returns 0 when the total opponent loss is below 1, 1 when it reaches the opponent's LP; otherwise picks a slot with ai_choose_slot_from_mask(own side, mask): none 0, an opponent slot 1, an own slot 1 only when its damage is at least 500 and it has no planned attack in the saved plan while the controller can enter battle, else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x0fff: for every slot 0-10 of both sides in ai_get_target_mask(ctx) holding raw card 0x16f8 owned by the controller, estimates the LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, rec, 1, 0)) with the opponent losing half its visible ATK and keeps the record with the largest opponent loss; returns ai_eval_damage_combo(ctx, mask, best record) (tail call; Ghidra shows no return value, hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Damage check for the card 0x1ec8 in side's monster zone slot: counters c = duel_core_get_counter_count(side, slot, 0x0b), plus 1 when the slot has no once-per-turn marker 0xfb6; the opponent's loss is set to 1000 * c and ai_estimate_card_lp_change(side, slot, 0x1ec8, 3, out, 1, 0) adjusts it. False when the opponent's loss is below 1 or the own loss reaches the own LP; then adds every other face-up 0x1ec8 in side's zones 0-4 (same formula) while the summed own loss stays below the own LP, and returns true when the summed opponent loss reaches the opponent's LP. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ai_eval_change_to_defense_position, ai_handler_check_board_1ec8).

AI handler of card 0x1e79: repeatedly picks a cost slot from ai_get_target_mask(ctx) with ai_choose_cost_as_side(ctx, controller, card, mask, 1); counts picked slots that can be sent to the Graveyard and whose card has off-field attribute 4, sets the opponent's loss to 100 * (that count + own Graveyard monsters of attribute 4), estimates the LP change and accumulates it; returns 0 when the accumulated own loss reaches the own LP, 1 when the opponent's reaches the opponent's LP, removes the slot from the mask and continues; returns 0 when the mask is empty. When the chooser returns -1 with a non-empty mask the loop repeats with the same mask (read literally; it relies on the chooser succeeding). Side effects: those of the cost chooser (view side switched and restored). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x16d7: sets the opponent's loss to 300 * duel_effects_count_valid_targets(ctx), estimates the LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0)) and returns true when the opponent loses LP, the own loss stays below the own LP and the opponent's loss reaches the opponent's LP (lethal). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1cf8: estimates the LP change of one use (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0)); false unless the opponent loses LP and n = duel_effects_count_controller_hand_candidates(ctx) is non-zero; when the own side also loses LP, n is lowered until n uses no longer kill the own side (false at 0); true when n uses reach the opponent's LP, otherwise when n > 3. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x190e: needs ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx) or a discard (ai_choose_discard(own side, instance, 1)), the controller able to enter the Battle Phase and the ctx monster able to attack (ai_can_attack_now(own side, location)); then returns 1 when a monster zone 0-4 of either side accepted by the record filter (duel_effects_call_handler_08(ctx, side, slot)) scores at least 500 with ai_score_slot_vs_2000_atk, 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1754: false unless the controller can enter the Battle Phase and ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx) or a discard exists (ai_choose_discard(own side, instance, 1)); then, with n the opponent's spell/trap count (duel_core_count_spell_traps), true when n == 1 while ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < 0 and ai_get_plain_battle_dominance(own) >= 0, otherwise when n > 1. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x15b4: false when card 0x1614 or 0x17c2 is active on the opponent's side (duel_core_count_active_card_on_side); otherwise true when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx) or ai_choose_discard(own side, instance ctx +4 bits 5-13, 1) finds a discard. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

column2: bool ai_handler_check_board_wipe_common(void *ctx, int arg, int need_targets, int check_lethal, uint card)
column3: Shared body of board-wipe monster handlers (fifth argument in t0; arg is not used): false when need_targets is set and the opponent has no target (ai_count_targets_on_side), or when card != 0 and the own hand holds that card; true when the ctx monster cannot attack (ai_can_slot_attack false); with check_lethal and the controller able to enter battle, true when its ATK reaches the opponent's LP or the opponent has a face-down spell/trap; otherwise true when ai_get_battle_dominance(own side) < 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_handler_check_rule_state_1bc9); table stubs may jump into it (ai.md).

AI handler of card 0x1bc9: 0 unless some opponent slot 0-10 passes duel_effects_target_filter_flags_70(ctx, opponent, slot) and duel_core_can_send_slot_to_graveyard(opponent, slot); then returns ai_handler_check_board_wipe_common(ctx, arg, 0, 0, 0). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x18e8: false when the opponent has no hand card (block +0x0c) and no target (ai_count_targets_on_side); true when the ctx monster's ATK reaches the opponent's LP and the controller can enter the Battle Phase, or when the monster cannot attack (ai_can_slot_attack false); otherwise true when ai_get_battle_dominance(own side) < 1. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of cards 0x152a/0x152b: false when the ctx slot's flags word (slot +0x10, 0x09e2a56c + slot * 0x14 + side * 0xb3c) has bit 21 (cannot change position this turn); otherwise sets the handler selector (ctx +3 bits 4-5) to 1, counts the opponent's targets (ai_count_targets_on_side), sets the selector to 3 and returns true when the count is non-zero. Side effects: leaves ctx +3 selector = 3. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1d87: 0 when the ctx slot's flags word (slot +0x10) has bit 21 (cannot change position this turn). Otherwise base = visible ATK of the ctx monster; gets ai_get_target_mask(ctx) with the handler selector (ctx +3 bits 4-5) temporarily 1 (then set to 3); raises base to the highest visible ATK among the other own occupied monster zones, skipping those with flags bit 21 that are in the mask or in Defense Position; returns 1 when an opponent monster zone 0-4 in the mask, in Attack Position, has visible ATK >= base and visible DEF < base (ai_get_visible_stats), else 0. Side effects: leaves ctx +3 selector = 3. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Shared AI handler for Union monsters. For a card in a monster zone (location < 5): false while the timing-event queue 0x09e28f98 is non-empty or the monster already has a link to any own slot 0-10 (duel_core_get_link_kind_from); then requires ai_is_past_summon_step, refuses a non-monster with handler selector != 0, applies the turn-counter limit 0x09e2d1e0 < u32 0x09e029ac + u32 0x09e02a6c to cards 0x1c38, 0x1309, 0x10e7, 0x10e0, 0x10df, 0x10d6, and is true when ai_choose_slot_for_ctx(ctx, own side, -1, 0) >= 0. For an equipped card: false without a linked slot (duel_core_find_linked_slot); card 0x1cf4: option o = ai_get_card_option(ctx, duel_effects_get_available_effect_options(ctx, link)), true for o = 1; for o = 0 with a positive word at ctx slot +0x0c and an own linked monster, temporarily zeroes that word and the linked monster's position word (slot +0x06), re-plans (ai_get_planned_attacker(own, 0)) and is true when ai_compare_plans(0x09e276e4, own saved plan) > 1; cards 0x1916, 0x15d3, 0x15cf: true for option 1; otherwise true when the linked monster is on the opponent's side. Side effects: re-planning; slot words restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1295: needs the controller able to enter the Battle Phase and the ctx monster able to attack now (ai_can_attack_now); false when the monster is affected by an active 0x17a6 (ai_is_slot_affected_by_active_card_any_side) or the opponent has no monster; true when its ATK >= its DEF, otherwise only when the opponent's LP is below 2000. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x15ff: false unless the controller can enter the Battle Phase, ai_get_target_mask(ctx) is non-empty and ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, mask, 1) picks a target; true when the target's visible id is 0x1ce0 and ai_score_attacker_for_15ff(target side, slot) >= 100000; otherwise true when ai_get_battle_dominance(controller) >= 1 and the controller's opponent has more than 2 monsters. Side effects: those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x169b: false unless the controller can enter the Battle Phase; true when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx); otherwise needs the opponent's LP <= 2000 and at least 2 own face-up Archfiend monsters (duel_core_count_face_up_monsters_matching with card_db_is_archfiend), then sets ctx +3 bit 7 and returns true when ai_count_targets_on_side(ctx, own side) > 0, clearing bit 7 again. Side effects: ctx +3 bit 7 cleared on that path. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x17da: true when the opponent has valuable effect targets (ai_count_valuable_effect_targets); otherwise needs ai_is_past_summon_step and an own hand monster (highest card_db ATK among them); stores that ATK in u16 ctx +0x0c, returns true when ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) finds a target, and clears +0x0c. Side effects: those of the chooser; ctx +0x0c ends at 0. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1835: true when the controller can enter the Battle Phase, the ctx monster can attack now (ai_can_attack_now) and ai_choose_tribute_slot_2(own side, 0, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), &out) returns a slot (>= 0). No side effects known. Callers: 1 (ai_decide_optional_activation); also an AI priority table entry (see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1db4: sets the recorded-value count of ctx (+7 bits 1-7) to 1 and asks ai_choose_cost_as_side(ctx, own side, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) for a cost; when one exists, resets the count to 0, recomputes the target mask and asks again; true when both choices succeed. Side effects: ctx +7 count left at 1 after a failed first choice, else 0; those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x195b: true when the own side has at least 2 monsters in position 1 (duel_core_count_monsters_in_position(side, 1)), the controller can enter the Battle Phase and ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) finds a target. Side effects: those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1a0f: true when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx); otherwise needs ai_get_battle_dominance(own side) >= 0, an opponent monster in position 1, the controller able to enter the Battle Phase, and a target from ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1). Side effects: those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1a7b: false unless the own hand holds 0x19fd; true when the own side has a face-up Neo-Spacian (card_db_is_neo_spacian) and Neo Space is active (ai_is_neo_space_active) or the controller can enter the Battle Phase. Otherwise, when the side has 0x1d81 in hand or on the field and ai_choose_monster_zone_for_card(side, 0x19fd) gives a zone, places 0x19fd there in simulation (ai_sim_set_slot_card, face-up word slot +0x08 = 1), returns whether ai_try_card_from_table(side, 0x1d81, table D 0x09dffdc8, 0) succeeds, and clears the zone again (ai_sim_clear_slot_card). Side effects: dominance-stale flag 0x09e03070 |= 0x20 from the simulation helpers; those of ai_try_card_from_table. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1bde, for the controller c: n = min(ai_count_acceptable_candidates(c, card, 0), free monster zones); needed count and LP limit from ai_get_battle_dominance(c): >= 0 needs 2 and 1000, -1..-2 needs 1 and 2000, below -2 needs 1 and 3000; when the card has no LP cost (ai_get_lp_cost == 0) the limit is c's LP. True when n reaches the needed count and c's LP is at most the limit. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1b5a: true when some own hand card (list +0x124) gets a non-zero ai_rate_send_to_graveyard_benefit(card, 0, 0), otherwise when card 0x1817 is active on the own side. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1386: 0 when the own side has fewer than 3 monsters; 1 when ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < 1, when the opponent has valuable effect targets (ai_count_valuable_effect_targets), or when at least 3 opponent monsters are in Defense Position (ai_is_slot_defense_position); otherwise 1 only when the controller can enter the Battle Phase, the ctx monster can attack now and it has no planned attack in the own saved plan (attack entry +2 == 0). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x16e4: n = field cards of both sides (duel_core_count_field_cards(0) + (1)) plus both hand sizes (0x09e2a534 + 0x09e2b070); false when n is 0; otherwise sets the opponent's loss to 300 * n, estimates the LP change with ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0x28) and returns true when the own loss stays below the own LP and the opponent's loss reaches the opponent's LP. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1984: estimates the LP change (ai_estimate_lp_change(ctx, out, 1, 0)); false unless the opponent loses LP and the own loss stays below the own LP; true when the opponent's loss reaches its LP; otherwise (non-lethal) with handler selector 0 it requires ai_is_past_summon_step, and then is true when card 0x1964 or 0x1982 is active on the own side. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_decide_optional_activation); also an AI priority table entry (see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of cards 0x1c53/0x1d5d (boost b = 1000 / 500; other cards 0). Returns 0 when 0x134a affects the ctx monster (duel_core_count_active_card_affecting with the slot's spell immunity) and its visible ATK is below 1500 but would reach 1500 with b. When the monster has a planned attack in the own saved plan: 0 if that entry's damage (+0x18) is 0 or the plan value (ai_get_plan_value) already reaches the opponent's LP, 1 if plan value + b reaches it, else 0. Otherwise 0x1d5d needs no deck-out on 2 draws (ai_would_deck_out), 0x1c53 needs ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard or a discard (ai_choose_discard); then returns 1 when ai_simulate_attack(side, slot, b, 1, 0) is non-zero, else 0. Side effects: re-planning and the snapshot push/pop of ai_simulate_attack. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x14dc: needs ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx) or a discard, the controller able to enter the Battle Phase and the ctx monster able to attack now; attaches a temporary marker (kind 2, key = card, value 0) to the ctx slot, re-plans with ai_get_planned_attacker(own, -1), returns true when ai_compare_plans(working plan 0x09e276e4, own saved plan) > 1, and detaches the marker. Side effects: re-planning; temporary marker removed. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of cards 0x1f17/0x1e0a: true when ai_get_battle_dominance(own side) < 1, the controller can enter the Battle Phase and ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 2) finds a target (chooser flag 2). Side effects: those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Shared AI handler: n = ai_count_acceptable_candidates(own side, card, 0); card 0x16c4 caps n at 2 and 0x1482 at 3, both boosting 300 * n (other cards boost 0). Needs n > 0, the controller able to enter the Battle Phase and the ctx monster able to attack now; attaches a temporary marker (kind 0x12, key = card, value = boost) to the ctx slot, re-plans with ai_get_planned_attacker(own, -1), returns true when ai_compare_plans(0x09e276e4, own saved plan) > 1, and detaches the marker. Side effects: re-planning. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1edb: k = cards in the controller's Graveyard for which card_db_is_iron_chain is true; needs the controller able to enter the Battle Phase and the ctx monster able to attack now; attaches a temporary marker (kind 2, key = card, value 200 * k) to the ctx slot, re-plans with ai_get_planned_attacker(own, -1), returns true when ai_compare_plans(0x09e276e4, own saved plan) > 1, and detaches the marker. Side effects: re-planning. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Counts n = side's monster zones 0-4 with card 0x1ed1 active, no once-per-turn marker 0xfb6 and an LP amount (ai_get_slot_card_lp_amount(side, slot, 0) >= 0) that keeps the summed amounts below side's LP. With n > 0 it builds the mask of face-up race-0x15 monsters of both sides, takes the best visible ATK among side's masked monsters (none: returns 0) and returns 0 when an opponent masked monster in Attack Position has a higher visible ATK; otherwise returns n. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_sim_resolve_card_with_temp_link).

column2: void ai_sim_attach_power_injector_boost(int side, int count, uint mask)
column3: Simulation helper: for every monster zone 0-4 of both sides whose bit is in mask (side * 16 + slot), attaches count markers kind 2, key 0x1ed1, value 0 (duel_core_attach_effect). The first argument is not used. Side effects: effect markers added to those slots. Callers: 2 (ai_sim_boost_all_psychics, ai_handler_check_battle_1ed1).

Builds the mask of face-up race-0x15 monsters in zones 0-4 of both sides (ai_is_slot_face_up, duel_core_get_race) and calls ai_sim_attach_power_injector_boost(side, count, mask). Side effects: those markers. Callers: 1 (ai_sim_resolve_card_with_temp_link).

AI handler of card 0x1ed1: needs ai_is_past_summon_step, the controller c able to enter the Battle Phase and a non-empty ai_get_target_mask(ctx); n = c's zones with 0x1ed1 active, no 0xfb6 marker and an affordable LP amount (as in ai_eval_power_injector); with n > 0 attaches n boost markers to every masked monster (ai_sim_attach_power_injector_boost), re-plans with ai_get_planned_attacker(c, -1), removes n markers keyed by the ctx card from each masked slot's list (duel_core_detach_list_effects_by_key on slot +0x0a) and returns true when ai_compare_plans(0x09e276e4, c's saved plan) > 1. Side effects: re-planning; the markers are removed again. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x18cd: 0 unless the controller can enter the Battle Phase and either ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx) or ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < 0; then picks the own highest-ATK monster of ai_get_target_mask(ctx) (ai_pick_monster_by_stats(own, mask, 1, 0)); returns 1 when none is found or the pick has no marker keyed by the card (duel_core_slot_has_effect), 0 otherwise. Side effects: advances the duel RNG (the picker shuffles). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Only when ai_get_battle_dominance(own side) < 1: compares the ctx monster's ATK a with each opponent monster zone 0-4; true at once for a stronger monster with counters of type 0x10; otherwise counts the monsters with exactly ATK a and those of them with type-0x10 counters, and returns true when at least one has counters and at least 2 have ATK a. False when dominance >= 1. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ai_handler_check_battle_1b71, ai_handler_check_board_1b71).

AI handler of card 0x1b71: o = duel_effects_get_available_effect_options(ctx, link). With option bit 0 it sets u16 ctx +0x0c = 1 and returns 1 when ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, link, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) finds a target. With option bit 1 it returns ai_eval_ice_master_targets(ctx) when the controller cannot enter the Battle Phase or the ctx monster has no planned attack in the own saved plan, else 0. Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: writes u16 ctx +0x0c; those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1b52: false when the own side can Normal Summon now (ai_can_normal_summon_now), has a free monster zone and holds an Alien monster in hand (card_db_is_alien); otherwise true when the own side has at least 2 monsters and ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) finds a target. Side effects: those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Condition for card 0x1efa, for the controller c: needs c not to be the turn player or able to enter the Battle Phase, and the opponent to have a monster; ai_can_special_summon_card(ctx, arg, 0, 20-byte out) must succeed; then over c's zones 0-4 counts the slots with 0x1eda active that can attack now and the other slots inside ai_get_target_mask(ctx); true when both counts are positive. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_handler_respond_to_link_1efa).

AI handler of card 0x0e9d: index = ai_simulate_candidate_pick(ctx, own side); 0 when none; 0 when the picked candidate is in the hand (duel_core_get_candidate_location == 0x0b) and the side can Normal Summon now; otherwise returns ai_can_choose_costs_for_named_card(ctx, instance number of candidate entry 0x09e29928 + index * 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0). Side effects: those of the candidate simulation. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x167e. Ghidra's function is a 28-byte stub; the decompilation follows it into shared code with the stub's constants propagated (card 0x0fc9, no costs; confidence medium). Finds the instance of 0x0fc9 in the controller's hand or deck (deck copy wins); none: false; otherwise calls ai_should_summon_in_defense(own side, -1, instance, 0, 0, 1, 0, cost list, card, out record) and returns true when that returns 0 and the out record word +0x18 is positive. ai_get_target_mask and ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard are called with unused results. No side effects known. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1713 (28-byte stub decompiled into shared code with its constants: card 0x16f8, 1 cost; confidence medium): finds the instance of 0x16f8 in the controller's hand, deck or Graveyard (last found wins); none: false. Unless ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx), picks 1 cost with ai_choose_cost_for_current_link(own, card, target mask, 1) (none: false), records its instance and the highest current ATK among own monster costs. Returns true when ai_should_summon_in_defense(own, -1, instance, 0, 0, 1, cost count, cost instances, card, out) returns 0 and that best cost ATK is below the out record word +0x18. Side effects: those of the cost chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x187e (28-byte stub decompiled into shared code with its constants: card 0x186b searched in hand and deck, 1 cost; confidence medium): same test as ai_handler_check_cost_1713, true when ai_should_summon_in_defense(own, -1, instance, 0, 0, 1, cost count, cost instances, card, out) returns 0 and the best own monster cost ATK is below out +0x18. Side effects: those of the cost chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x195c (28-byte stub decompiled into shared code with its constants: card 0x1951 searched in hand, deck and Graveyard; confidence medium): unless ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx), picks 2 costs from the target mask with ai_choose_cost_for_current_link, then 1 more from a second target mask computed with u16 ctx +0x0c = 2 (reset to 0); any failed pick returns false. True when ai_should_summon_in_defense(own, -1, instance, 0, 0, 1, cost count, cost instances, card, out) returns 0 and the best own monster cost ATK is below out +0x18. Side effects: those of the cost chooser; ctx +0x0c restored to 0. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1ad1 (28-byte stub decompiled into shared code with its constants: card 0x1ad2 searched in hand and deck, 1 cost; confidence medium): same test as ai_handler_check_cost_1713, true when ai_should_summon_in_defense(own, -1, instance, 0, 0, 1, cost count, cost instances, card, out) returns 0 and the best own monster cost ATK is below out +0x18. Side effects: those of the cost chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1dc6 (28-byte stub decompiled into shared code with its constants: card 0x18ab searched in hand and deck, 3 costs; confidence medium): unless ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx), picks 3 costs with ai_choose_cost_for_current_link(own, card, mask, 1) (any failure: false); true when ai_should_summon_in_defense(own, -1, instance, 0, 0, 1, cost count, cost instances, card, out) returns 0 and the best own monster cost ATK is below out +0x18. Side effects: those of the cost chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1bbf: damage d = 500 + 300 * active copies of 0x159b on the own side; returns 1 when d reaches the opponent's LP. Otherwise re-plans (ai_get_plan_value(own)) and returns 1 when the ctx monster has no planned attack in the own saved plan, or when its attack entry's damage (+0x18) equals its current ATK and is below d (unsigned compare); 0 otherwise. Side effects: possible re-planning. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1bc0: v = 200 * own Graveyard monsters that are Volcanic (card_db_is_volcanic); 0 when v is 0; d = v + 300 * active copies of 0x159b; returns 1 when d reaches the opponent's LP, otherwise re-plans (ai_get_plan_value) and returns 1 when the ctx monster has no planned attack, or its attack entry's damage (+0x18) equals its ATK and is below d; 0 otherwise. Side effects: possible re-planning. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1e77: c = counters of type 0 on the ctx slot; first pick ai_try_choose_candidates(own, 6, card, c + 100, 0) (none: 0) and remembers the selected candidate's card. b = the own best attacker ATK (ai_get_best_attacker_atk(own, -1, 0)), at least 1400; when the ctx monster's visible battle stat exceeds b it picks again with parameter c + 102 and returns 1 when nothing is picked or the same card is picked, 0 otherwise; else returns 1. Side effects: those of ai_try_choose_candidates (duel candidate list rebuilt). No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1bfe: h = own hand size, minus 1 when the card is in the hand (location 0x0b). 0 when the own side would deck out after 4 draws; 1 when ai_is_normal_spell_in_graveyard(ctx); 0 when the own side has no monster; when h == 1 returns 0 if 0x1c0f or 0x1c10 is in the hand without being active on the own side, else 1; when h != 1 returns 1. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1c25: f = ai_is_flint_attached_to_ctx_card(ctx). f == 1: raises the recorded-value count (ctx +7 bits 1-7) by one, tests ai_choose_cost_for_current_link(own, card, -1, 1) >= 0 and lowers the count again. f == 0: true when ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < 1 and ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, -1, 1) >= 0. Other values: false. Side effects: those of the choosers; ctx +7 restored. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1cdf: with handler selector 0 (spell/trap activation), true when ai_is_card_count_below(ctx, 1, 0) and the own side owns a Crystal Beast (ai_owns_matching_card with card_db_is_crystal_beast); with another selector, true when free own spell/trap zones + 1 <= counters of type 4 on the ctx slot + 2. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1ba7: with handler selector 0, true when the own field zone is empty or face-down (visible id of slot 10 is 0, or its face-up word 0x09e2a62c + side * 0xb3c is 0); otherwise true when ai_check_draw_option_for_1ba7(ctx), else sets u16 ctx +0x0c = 2 and returns whether ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) finds a target. Side effects: ctx +0x0c left at 2 on that path; those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1bd2: n = min(ai_count_acceptable_candidates(own, card, duel_effects_get_candidate_param(ctx)), 2, free own spell/trap zones (minus 1 when the card is in the hand)); true when ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < -2 or n == 2. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1bd3: threshold from ai_get_battle_dominance(own): > 0 gives 9, 0 gives 7, -1..-2 give 4, below -2 gives 1; true when the opponent has at least that many field cards (duel_core_count_field_cards), otherwise when the opponent has a valuable spell/trap (ai_count_valuable_spell_traps > 0). No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1cdb: 0 unless ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < 0. With m = own monsters and Crystal Beast counts d (deck), g (Graveyard monsters) and s (spell/trap zones): 1 when 0x1bd3 is in the hand, m < 2, g + s > 3 and the threshold test of ai_handler_check_dominance_1bd3 passes; 1 when at least 2 copies of 0x1ba1 are in the hand, m < 2 and d > 1; 1 when at least 3 copies of 0x1bd4 are in the hand, m <= 2 and g + s >= 3; 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

Returns 1 when option bit 0 is available (duel_effects_get_available_effect_options(ctx, NULL)), ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < 1, and 1000 * ai_count_targets_with_filter(ctx, duel_effects_filter_monster_target_b) + the ctx monster's ATK reaches the opponent's best visible battle stat (ai_get_best_visible_battle_stat); 0 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ai_evaluate_card_option).

AI handler of card 0x1c03: 0 unless the own side is the turn player (0x09e2d1d8) and the phase word 0x09e2d1e8 is 2 or 4 (Main Phase 1 or 2). Returns 1 when option bit 0 is available and the same test as ai_can_outclass_with_per_target_boost passes (dominance < 1, 1000 per filtered target + ATK reaches the opponent's best visible stat); otherwise, with option bit 1, in phase 2 returns 0 when the ctx monster has a planned attack (after ai_get_plan_value), and returns 1 when ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < -2; 0 otherwise. Side effects: possible re-planning. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of cards 0x1c0c/0x1c0d: re-plans with ai_get_plan_value(own side) and returns true when the ctx monster has no planned attack in the own saved plan and ai_choose_target_as_controller(ctx, arg, card, ai_get_target_mask(ctx), 1) finds a target. Side effects: possible re-planning; those of the chooser. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1c4e: false when the own hand has fewer than 3 cards; picks a hand card to send with ai_choose_hand_card_to_send(own, 0x0e, duel_effects_select_filter_hand_candidate, 0, 1, 0, 0) (none: false) and requires ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6); true when the selected candidate's estimated off-field ATK (ai_estimate_off_field_atk) is higher than that of the hand card to send. Side effects: those of the candidate pick. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of cards 0x1bd0/0x1bd1: picks the own side's least valuable slot of ai_get_target_mask(ctx) (ai_pick_least_valuable_slot(own, 0, mask, 1, 0, 0)); none: 0; when that card is a valuable effect card (ai_is_valuable_effect_card) of which the own side has no copy in hand and exactly one on the field, 0. Then, with ctx +3 bit 7 set, picks the opponent's slot by threat (ai_pick_slot_by_threat(opponent, 0, mask)) and clears the bit; returns 1 when that slot's flags word (+0x10) has bit 10 clear, when its card is a valuable effect card, or for card 0x1bd1 when ai_get_battle_dominance(own) < 1; 0 otherwise. Side effects: ctx +3 bit 7 cleared. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1c2f: needs ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6) and a hand monster to send (ai_choose_hand_monster_to_send(own, 0, 1)); v1 = max of the estimated off-field ATK and DEF of the selected candidate, v2 = the same for the hand monster; true when ai_rate_send_to_graveyard_benefit(hand monster, 1, 0) is non-zero, otherwise when v2 < v1. Side effects: those of the candidate pick. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x18a4: 1 when the controller can enter the Battle Phase, the own LP is at most 1000 and ai_estimate_off_field_atk(own, 0x18a0) is at least the opponent's best visible battle stat (ai_get_best_visible_battle_stat); 0 otherwise. No side effects. No direct caller (AI priority table entry; see docs/formats/ai-tables.md).

AI handler of card 0x1cad: needs ai_can_choose_candidates_for_ctx(ctx, 6); simulates summoning the selected candidate with ai_sim_summon_card_to_field(own, own, -1, candidate card, candidate instance, 0, 1, cost list holding the ctx monster's instance, card, out record, 1, 4, 0, 1) and returns true when that succeeds (>= 0) and the out record word +0x18 exceeds the ctx monster's current ATK; then calls ai_pop_state_snapshot.
